18	}

20	\newcommand{\sys}{\textsc{AgentProf}\xspace}
21	\newcommand{\operation}{\texttt{operation}\xspace}
22	\newcommand{\opstack}{\texttt{operation stack}\xspace}
23	\providecommand{\Description}[1]{}
24	
25	\begin{document}
26	
27	\title{\sys: Semantic Profiling for AI Agents}
28	\author{Anonymous Submission}
29	\affiliations{}
30	
31	\maketitle
32	
33	\begin{abstract}
34	AI agents orchestrate long-running activities across users, tools, and system
35	resources, producing growing populations of execution histories.
36	% AI 智能体编排跨越用户、工具和系统资源的长时间活动，并产生不断增长的执行历史集合。
37	Developers need population-level answers about where failures concentrate,
38	which workflows trigger unsafe effects, and which task categories consume the
39	most budget.
40	% 开发者需要从群体层面回答故障集中在哪里、哪些工作流触发不安全副作用，以及哪类任务消耗最多预算。
41	Unlike stable code paths, natural-language intent lacks shared identity, and
42	native execution nesting does not provide a reusable cross-run hierarchy of
43	semantic responsibility.
44	% 与稳定代码路径不同，自然语言意图缺少共享身份，而原生执行嵌套不能提供可跨运行复用的语义责任层次。
45	Existing agent tools trace runs, group metadata, and aggregate metrics, but do
46	not combine source-linked system effects, conserved additive measures, and
47	selectable query-time operation stacks over the same histories.
48	% 现有 agent 工具可以追踪运行、分组 metadata 并聚合指标，但不会在同一批历史上结合源连接的系统副作用、守恒的可加度量和可选择的查询时 operation stack。
49	Agent observability needs profiling, not only debugging.
50	% 智能体可观测性需要 profiling，而不仅仅是 debugging。
51	\sys realizes this insight through a \emph{semantic operation stack model}
52	with uniform weighted \emph{operations}, query-time \emph{operation stacks},
53	pluggable field and stack construction, label-free recurrence over visible
54	action transitions, and pprof-compatible output.
55	% \sys 通过语义 operation stack 模型实现这一洞见：统一加权 operation、查询时 operation stack、可插拔字段与栈构造、可见 action transition 上的无标签 recurrence，以及 pprof 兼容输出。
56	We evaluate \sys on a 20-task real Codex capture suite, 405 human-staged
57	CodeTraceBench trajectories, three complete public localization benchmarks,
58	287 OSWorld-Human sessions, and four public cost workloads.
59	% 我们在 20 个真实 Codex 任务、405 条带人工 stage 的 CodeTraceBench 轨迹、三个完整公开 localization benchmark、287 个 OSWorld-Human session 和四个公开成本 workload 上评估 \sys。
60	Within the declared process/tool scope, AgentSight capture and joining reach
61	100.0\% precision and 96.6\% recall, reject 1{,}629/1{,}629 concurrent-control
62	effects. Label-free recurrence raises ordinary B$^3$ F1 against human stages
63	from 0.541 to 0.649, and semantic grouping improves MAP over raw action in all
64	three localization benchmarks.
65	% 范围化的 AgentSight-to-\sys 路径以 100.0% precision 和 96.6% recall 连接副作用并拒绝全部 1,629 个对照；相对人工 stage partition 的标准 B$^3$ F1 从 0.541 提升至 0.649，semantic grouping 还在三个 localization benchmark 上均提高相对 raw action 的 MAP。
66	Evaluated task-family and action backends reach 0.695 and 0.498 macro-F1,
67	label-free recurrence reaches 0.680 boundary F1 and 0.786 B$^3$ F1 on
68	OSWorld-Human, and \sys constructs a 27{,}765-operation profile in 1.17\,s.
69	% 评估的 task-family 与 action backend 分别达到 0.695 和 0.498 macro-F1；在 OSWorld-Human 上，无标签 recurrence 达到 0.680 boundary F1 和 0.786 B$^3$ F1；\sys 在 1.17 秒内构建包含 27,765 个 operation 的 profile。
70	\end{abstract}
71	
72	% AI agents increasingly orchestrate long-running, multi-step
73	% activities involving thousands to millions of interactions with
74	% users, tools, and system resources.
75	% To optimize the quality, safety, and cost of agents, developers must 
76	% analyze behaviors across thousands of runs to 
77	% find where failures concentrate, 
78	% locate the workflow phases triggering unsafe effects, 
79	% and identify the tasks that consumes most budget. 
80	
81	% While performance profiling traditionally answers these questions 
82	% for classic software by aggregating resource consumption, 
83	% traditional profilers fail for agents.
84	% unlike traditional software where code paths provide a natural hierarchy for profiling, 
85	% agent behaviors are driven by unstructured natural language prompts 
86	% and lack deterministic execution stacks. 
87	% To bridge this gap, we propose the Semantic Operation Stack model. 
88	% First, we unify all heterogeneous agent activities (prompts, tool calls, 
89	% and system I/O) into a single structured record called an operation. 
90	% Second, we construct dynamic call stacks at query time by projecting 
91	% these operations onto user-defined semantic fields (e.g., intent $\rightarrow$ phase $\rightarrow$ action), merging identical sequences to generate flame graphs.
92	
93	% We implement this model in AgentProf, an offline profiler 
94	% with pluggable algorithms for intent attribution and stack construction, 
95	% compiling local agent trajectories into standard, pprof-compatible profiles. 
96	
97	
98	%% ===================================================================
99	\section{Introduction}
100	\label{sec:intro}
101	
102	%% ¶1: Background + context
103	AI agents~\cite{sweagent,codex,claudecode,osworld} orchestrate multi-step activities
104	across a high-level intent layer (prompts, LLM calls, and tool invocations) and
105	a low-level system-effects layer (process spawns and file and network I/O).
106	% AI 智能体~\cite{sweagent,codex,claudecode,osworld}编排跨越两层的多步骤活动：高层意图（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用）和低层系统副作用（进程创建、文件和网络 I/O）。
107	As agents evolve from short scripts into complex systems, production teams
108	accumulate many trajectories.
109	% 随着智能体从短小脚本发展为复杂系统，生产团队会积累大量轨迹。
110	
111	%% ¶2: Problem
112	Developers lack population-level answers about agent quality, safety, and cost.
113	Which categories of tasks consume the most token budget? Where do
114	failures concentrate across workflows? Which behavioral patterns
115	trigger unsafe system effects?
116	% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨轨迹和交互分析运维行为。哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算？故障跨工作流集中在哪里？哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用？
117	At scale, manual trajectory inspection is slow and expensive~\cite{agentrewardbench},
118	while LLM judging requires a separate evaluator pass per
119	trajectory~\cite{agentrewardbench,llm-as-judge}.
120	% 在规模化时，人工轨迹检查缓慢且昂贵，而逐轨迹 LLM judging 需要为每次运行单独执行一次 evaluator。
121	
122	%% ¶3: Structural cause
123	Agent trajectories lack two structures needed for cross-run profiling.
124	% 智能体轨迹缺乏使这种聚合成为可能的两个结构。
125	Responsibility lies in semantic categories such as task intent and tool
126	operation rather than stable function names. Natural-language prompts provide
127	no common identifier for shared intent.
128	% 负责实体是任务意图和工具操作等语义类别而非稳定函数名；自然语言提示词不会为共享意图提供共同标识符。
129	Native execution nesting may exist, but it does not provide a reusable
130	cross-run hierarchy of semantic responsibility. A prompt sequence may
131	represent multiple tasks, while one task may belong to a larger task.
132	% 原生执行嵌套可以存在，但它不会自动提供可跨运行复用的语义责任层次：一段提示序列可能表示多个任务，而一个任务又可能属于更大的任务。
133	Thus adapting profiling requires stable semantic identifiers and an
134	attribution hierarchy that does not depend on a runtime stack.
135	% 因此，适配 profiling 需要稳定的语义身份，以及不依赖运行时调用栈的归因层次。
136	
137	%% ¶4: Existing solutions
138	Existing agent observability lacks this profiling abstraction.
139	Tools provide rich tracing, metadata aggregation, and population
140	dashboards~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,datadog-llmobs,laminar-signals},
141	and some derive hierarchical categories across traces and aggregate latency, cost,
142	or evaluation metrics~\cite{langsmith-insights,datadog-patterns}, while recent
143	research canonicalizes actions into process profiles or cross-run graphs for
144	monitoring and recovery~\cite{traceprobe2026,graphectory2026,webgrapheval2025,
145	hodoscope2026,tracegraph2026}. These systems establish
146	semantic grouping, metric rollups, and cross-run analysis. They do not combine
147	source-linked agent and system effects, conservation of arbitrary additive
148	measures, and selectable query-time operation stacks over the same histories.
149	% 现有智能体工具提供 tracing、tag/metadata 聚合和群体级 dashboard；部分工具跨 trace 派生分层类别并聚合 latency、cost 或 evaluation metric，但不会将可加系统副作用连接回负责的 agent action，再按语义字段聚合为可选 pprof profile。
150	
151	%% ¶5: Model
152	Agent observability needs profiling, not only debugging.
153	% 智能体可观测性需要 profiling，而不仅仅是 debugging。
154	Profiling transfers by projecting resources onto stable semantic tags in an
155	attribution hierarchy.
156	% 当资源被投影到负责的语义实体、赋予稳定标签并分层归因时，profiling 方法论可以迁移。
157	Our \emph{semantic operation stack model} provides this structure through
158	operations and operation stacks.
159	% 我们的语义 operation stack 模型通过 operation 和 operation stack 两个组件实现这种迁移。
160	\emph{Operations} are uniform records with string fields and additive measures
161	that represent prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations, and system effects
162	without type-specific objects.
163	% Operation 是带有字符串字段和可加度量的统一记录，无需特定类型对象即可表示提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用。
164	\emph{Operation stacks} replace the runtime call stack by ordering selected
165	fields. Changing those fields attributes the same operations by task category,
166	execution phase, session, or action type (Figure~\ref{fig:flamegraph}).
167	% Operation stack 通过排列所选字段替代运行时调用栈；改变这些字段即可按任务类别、执行阶段、会话或操作类型归因同一组 operation（Figure~\ref{fig:flamegraph}）。
168	
169	%% ¶6: System
170	We implement this model in \sys, an offline profiler that compiles
171	local agent trajectories into pprof-compatible profiles~\cite{pprof}
172	(Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
173	% 我们在 \sys 中实现此模型，这是一个离线 profiler，将本地智能体轨迹编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile（Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。
174	\emph{Intent attribution} derives stable, low-cardinality tags from
175	natural-language fields via regex rules, a local LLM tagger, or unsupervised
176	clustering, replacing function-name identity.
177	% 意图归因通过正则规则、本地 LLM 标注器或无监督聚类从自然语言字段派生稳定、低基数的标签，提供传统 profiling 从函数名获得的语义身份。
178	\emph{Stack construction} uses either selected fields or label-free recurrence
179	over visible cross-session action transitions to replace runtime nesting.

226	\section{Background and Motivation}
227	\label{sec:background}
228	
229	\subsection{LLMs and AI Agents}
230	% AI 智能体
231	
232	A typical agent trajectory interleaves two layers of
233	activity~\cite{sweagent,codex,claudecode,agentsight}.
234	% 典型的智能体轨迹交织两层活动。
235	At the intent layer, an agent receives prompts, issues LLM calls, and invokes
236	tools for code execution, search, and file editing.
237	% 在意图层，智能体接收用户提示词、发出 LLM 调用并调用工具（代码执行、网络搜索、文件编辑）。
238	Tool invocations trigger lower-layer process, file, and network
239	effects~\cite{agentsight}. Trajectories repeat this cycle, and teams accumulate
240	many trajectories.
241	% 每次工具调用在下层触发系统副作用：进程创建、文件读写和网络请求。
242	% 单条轨迹会重复这样的意图-副作用循环，团队也会积累许多轨迹。
243	
244	\subsection{System Profiling}
245	% 系统 Profiling
246	
247	Profiling aggregates measurements to attribute resources to responsible
248	entities rather than debugging a single execution.
249	% Profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。
250	Traditional profilers sample execution, attach each sample to its call stack,
251	and fold identical stacks~\cite{pprof,flamegraphs}.
252	% 在传统软件中，profiling 管线如下工作：profiler 周期性采样执行状态，将每个样本附加到当前调用栈，合并具有相同栈的样本。
253	Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} and pprof~\cite{pprof} call graphs visualize
254	aggregate cost by width or node size, while Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} queries
255	trace events and derives new ones.
256	% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}和 pprof~\cite{pprof} 调用图可视化其结果，宽度或节点大小代表聚合开销。
257	These tools start from stable code identifiers and runtime stacks, although
258	pprof can also promote \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} values to pseudo-frames.
259	% 这些工具通常从稳定的代码标识符和运行时栈开始；pprof 也可以聚合标签，并将 \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} 值提升为伪帧。
260	Agent profiles must instead derive stable semantic fields and connect them to
261	downstream effects.
262	% 智能体轨迹则必须先获得稳定的语义责任字段，并将其连接到下游副作用，之后才能形成这类 profile 视图。
263	
264	\subsection{Challenges for Agent Profiling}
265	% 智能体 Profiling 的挑战
266	
267	Existing tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel} record agent events as
268	per-execution span trees for single-run debugging.
269	% 现有工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel}将智能体事件记录为按执行划分的 span 树，有效调试单次运行。
270	AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} bridges intent and system-effect layers by
271	correlating extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF) system events with intercepted LLM
272	traffic, but the resulting recordings still lack aggregate profiling.
273	% AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 通过关联 eBPF 捕获的系统事件与拦截的 LLM 流量来桥接意图层和系统副作用层，但生成的记录仍缺乏聚合分析能力。
274	
275	
276	Agent profiling faces two challenges. First, responsibility lies in semantic
277	categories such as task intent and workflow phase, not code paths.
278	% 在传统软件中，profiling 将开销归因到代码路径，但在智能体轨迹中，相关实体是语义类别（如任务意图和工作流阶段）。
279	Standards represent application-supplied span attributes~\cite{otel,
280	openinference}, but natural-language histories lack stable categories because
281	different prompts or tools can express the same intent.
282	% 现有标准可以在 span 中表示应用提供的属性，但自然语言历史不会自动提供稳定的责任类别：表达相同意图的两个提示词和工具调用可能使用不同字符串。
283	
284	Second, agent trajectories lack a runtime call hierarchy for semantic attribution.
285	% 第二个挑战是智能体轨迹没有能够自动提供语义归因的运行时调用层次。
286	In CPU profiling, the stack attributes \texttt{malloc}'s cost simultaneously
287	to \texttt{parse}, \texttt{process}, and \texttt{main}.
288	% 在 CPU 分析中，调用栈决定了每个层级的归因：\texttt{malloc} 的开销同时属于 \texttt{parse}、\texttt{process} 和 \texttt{main}。
289	A prompt sequence may contain one or several tasks within a larger workflow,
290	yet no runtime mechanism marks its boundaries or attribution granularity.
291	% 一串提示词可能构成一个任务也可能是多个任务，一个任务可能是更大工作流的一部分，但没有运行时机制标记这些边界或决定在哪个粒度归因开销。
292	RQ1 evaluates how this missing hierarchy affects attribution, while RQ3
293	evaluates constructed groups and boundaries.
294	% RQ1 评估其归因后果，RQ3 评估构造出的 group 与 boundary。
295	
296	\subsection{Design Requirements for Agent Profiling}
297	% 智能体 Profiling 的设计需求
298	
299	Traditional profiling relies on three mechanisms supplied automatically by the call stack.
300	% 传统 profiling 依赖调用栈自动提供的三种机制。
301	Agent profiling requires all three without a call stack:
302	% 智能体 profiling 需要这三种机制，但必须在没有调用栈的情况下实现：
303	
304	\begin{description}
305	\item[D1: Cross-layer resource projection.]
306	The profiler must connect resource consumption from file I/O and process
307	spawns to the responsible prompts and LLM calls.
308	% 分析器必须将系统层的资源消耗连接到意图层的语义类别。
309	\item[D2: Stable tags for folding.]
310	Without stable function names, the profiler must derive short, repeatable tags
311	from natural language before folding.
312	% 智能体提示词是自然语言，因此分析器必须在折叠前派生短小、稳定、可重复的标签。
313	\item[D3: Hierarchical attribution.]
314	Because span trees do not encode semantic responsibility through function-call
315	nesting, the profiler must construct attribution hierarchies from the data.
316	% 智能体 span 树不通过函数调用嵌套编码语义责任，因此分析器必须从数据中构造归因层次。
317	\end{description}
318	
319	%% ===================================================================
320	\section{Design}
321	% 设计
322	\label{sec:design}
323	
324	The design maps D1--D3 to ingestion, tags, and operation stacks.
325	% 三个需求（跨层资源投影、稳定标签和分层归因）驱动了设计。
326	For D1, source-specific ingestion links each system effect to its intent, and
327	operations preserve inherited semantic fields for projection and folding.
328	% Source-specific ingestion 与 operation 表示共同满足 D1：ingestion 将系统副作用连接到负责的意图后，operation 保留该连接及继承的语义字段，\sys 随后投影并折叠这些字段。
329	For D2, intent attribution derives stable tags from natural-language fields.
330	% Attribution and Stack Construction 中的意图归因通过从自然语言字段派生稳定标签满足 D2。
331	For D3, \emph{operation stacks} replace runtime stacks with query-time field
332	projections, supporting multiple attribution granularities over the same data.
333	% Operation stack 通过以查询时字段投影替代运行时调用栈，在多个粒度层级归因资源来满足 D3，使同一数据支持多种视图而无需重建输入。
334	
335	The profiling pipeline has four stages: (1)~parse raw trajectories into operations, (2)~enrich operations via intent attribution or mapping rules, (3)~project each operation onto a stack frame sequence chosen at query time, and (4)~fold operations with identical stacks, summing their weights.
336	% 分析管线有四个阶段：(1) 将原始轨迹解析为 operation，(2) 通过意图归因或映射规则丰富 operation，(3) 将每个 operation 投影到查询时选择的栈帧序列上，(4) 折叠具有相同栈的 operation 并求和权重。

351	\subsection{Semantic Operation Stack Model}
352	% 语义 Operation Stack 模型
353	\label{sec:ops}
354	
355	%% ¶1: Operations
356	\sys represents each activity from the intent and system-effect layers as an
357	\operation, a weighted record with string fields and additive measures.
358	% 由于智能体活动跨越 Background and Motivation 中描述的意图层和系统副作用层，分析器不应在数据表示层面区分它们。
359	% 因此 \sys 将每个活动表示为单一抽象——operation，一个带有字符串字段和可加度量的加权记录。
360	Each operation carries string fields (\texttt{project},
361	\texttt{agent}, \texttt{session}, \texttt{prompt\_tag},
362	\texttt{kind}, \texttt{model}, \texttt{path}, \texttt{domain},
363	\texttt{status}, \ldots) and additive measures (token count,
364	duration, event count).
365	% 每个 operation 携带字符串字段（\texttt{project}、\texttt{agent}、\texttt{session}、\texttt{prompt\_tag}、\texttt{kind}、\texttt{model}、\texttt{path}、\texttt{domain}、\texttt{status} 等）和可加度量（token 数、持续时间、事件数）。
366	The same schema represents prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations, file reads,
367	GUI clicks, and process events. Populated fields distinguish these operation
368	types.
369	% 提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用、文件读取、GUI 点击和进程事件都是具有相同 schema 的 operation，仅通过哪些字段有值来区分。
370	When a tool invocation triggers system effects, ingestion propagates its
371	semantic fields to the resulting operations, allowing downstream resource
372	weights to fold under the responsible intent.
373	% 当工具调用触发系统副作用时，输入处理将其语义字段传播到生成的 operation，使下游资源权重能够折叠到负责的意图之下。
374	
375	%% ¶2: Operation Stacks
376	\label{sec:stacks}
377	An \opstack replaces the runtime call stack to provide hierarchical attribution
378	for agent trajectories.
379	% 一个 operation stack 为智能体轨迹提供分层归因，替代运行时调用栈。
380	In CPU profiling, a call stack determines which code paths
381	share responsibility for a resource cost.
382	% 在 CPU 分析中，调用栈决定哪些代码路径共同承担资源开销。
383	In \sys, an ordered list of fields
384	$[f_1, f_2, \ldots, f_k]$ projects each operation $o$ to a frame
385	sequence $\langle o.f_1, o.f_2, \ldots, o.f_k \rangle$, and
386	operations with identical sequences are merged, summing their
387	weights.
388	% Operation stack 承担相同角色：有序字段列表 $[f_1, f_2, \ldots, f_k]$ 将每个 operation $o$ 投影到帧序列 $\langle o.f_1, o.f_2, \ldots, o.f_k \rangle$，具有相同序列的 operation 被合并，权重求和。
389	Unlike a call stack, the fields are chosen at query time, not
390	determined by execution.
391	% 与调用栈不同，字段在查询时选择，而非由执行决定。
392	The same operations can therefore support a flat task summary, a per-session
393	tree, a semantic phase/action hierarchy, or a trajectory organized by the
394	dataset's own annotations. Field selection changes attribution but not the data.
395	% 因此同一组 operation 可归因为扁平任务摘要、固定会话树、语义阶段/操作层次或使用数据集自身标注的轨迹，改变字段即改变归因方式而无需改变数据。
396	Sessions and spans are optional fields, not hierarchy levels. The same data
397	supports debugging views with \texttt{session} and aggregate profiling views
398	without that field.
399	% 会话和 span 是可选的 operation 字段而非固定层次级别，因此同一数据既支持调试视图（包含 \texttt{session}）也支持聚合 profiling 视图（排除它）。
400	
401	We formalize each selectable profile as a view $(\varphi, \sigma, w)$. For operation $o$, the predicate
402	$\varphi(o)$ decides inclusion, an ordered field list
403	$[f_1, \ldots, f_k]$ defines
404	$\sigma(o)=\langle o.f_1, \ldots, o.f_k \rangle$, and $w(o)\geq0$ supplies its
405	weight.
406	% 一个视图是三元组 $(\varphi, \sigma, w)$：谓词 $\varphi$ 选择参与的 operation，栈函数 $\sigma = [f_1, \ldots, f_k]$ 将每个 operation 映射到其帧序列，权重函数 $w$ 赋予非负度量。
407	Users choose the stack function independently of the predicate and weight
408	function. Four built-in resource
409	choices define $\varphi$ and $w$ for common questions: (1)~\texttt{tokens} weights LLM
410	calls by token count, (2)~\texttt{time} weights timed operations by duration,
411	(3)~\texttt{files} weights file operations by event count, and
412	(4)~\texttt{network} weights network operations by event count.
413	% 栈函数保持独立可选。四个内置资源选择为常见问题定义 $\varphi$ 和 $w$：\texttt{tokens}（LLM 调用按 token 数加权）、\texttt{time}（所有计时操作按时长加权）、\texttt{files}（文件操作按事件数加权）和 \texttt{network}（网络操作按事件数加权）。
414	
415	\subsection{Attribution and Stack Construction}
416	% 归因与栈构造
417	\label{sec:intent}
418	
419	\paragraph{Intent attribution.}
420	% 意图归因。
421	Intent attribution maps natural-language fields to short, stable, repeatable
422	tags, supplying the identifiers that traditional profiling obtains from
423	function names.
424	% 意图归因将自然语言的提示词映射为短小、稳定、可重复的标签，为智能体轨迹提供传统 profiling 从函数名免费获得的稳定标识符，详见 Background and Motivation。
425	The framework supports three pluggable backends.
426	% 该框架支持三种可插拔后端。
427	Explicit rules provide repeatable user control, a local model tags
428	natural-language fields, and unsupervised grouping discovers candidate
429	categories that developers can encode as rules.
430	% 显式规则提供可重复的用户控制，本地模型标注自然语言字段，无监督分组帮助发现供后续规则编写使用的候选类别。
431	Structured trajectories use the same interface to derive fields from existing
432	action and quality attributes.
433	% 结构化轨迹使用同一接口从现有 action 和质量属性派生字段。
434	All backends emit ordinary operation fields, keeping the stack model
435	independent of how a tag was obtained.
436	% 所有 backend 都输出普通 operation 字段，使 stack 模型独立于标签的获取方式。
437	
438	\paragraph{Stack construction.}
439	% 栈构造。
440	With an ordered field list, stack construction directly projects the available
441	fields.
442	% 当用户提供有序字段列表时，投影是直接的。
443	When users enable automatic construction, \sys induces operation stacks
444	without a user-specified field list through \emph{label-free recurrence}.
445	Visible actions are action-field values available before target annotations
446	are read. The constructor uses adjacent visible-action recurrence across
447	reference sessions, so weak or unseen transitions start segments and recurring
448	transitions continue them. Each segment's run-length-compressed action sequence
449	becomes a reusable stack-frame value.
450	% 它学习哪些相邻可见 action 会在参考 session 中稳定重复。较弱或未见过的转移开始新的 segment；重复出现的转移延续当前 segment，其经游程压缩的 action 序列成为可复用的 stack-frame value。
451	The derived group and stack-frame values are ordinary operation fields, so the stack
452	function can compose them with task, phase, action, or session fields at query
453	time.
454	% 派生出的 group 与 stack-frame value 是普通 operation 字段，因此栈函数可在查询时将其与 task、phase、action 或 session 字段组合。
455	The constructor can learn from a separate label-free operation corpus, so it
456	does not use the target session's problem annotations.
457	% 参考数据可以是独立的无标签 operation 语料，因此构造过程不使用目标 session 的问题标注。
458

460	\section{Implementation}
461	% 实现
462	\label{sec:impl}
463	
464	\sys is an approximately 9.8K-line offline Rust command-line interface that
465	implements the semantic operation stack model (Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
466	% \sys 将 operation 和 stack 模型实现为离线 Rust CLI（约 9.8K 行代码，Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。
467	
468	\paragraph{Input reconstruction.}
469	% 输入重建。
470	\sys reads Codex and Claude Code local JSON Lines (JSONL) histories and
471	operation JSONL.
472	For native histories, it reconstructs prompts, LLM calls, and tool invocations.
473	Because the current CLI does not read AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} recordings
474	directly, those recordings pass through a source-specific adapter. For
475	AgentSight recordings, the declared process/tool scope contains the captured
476	target agent process and its launched tool command, excluding concurrent
477	control activity. AgentSight joins system effects within this scope, and the
478	adapter emits operations carrying those links.
479	\sys then projects and folds their fields and weights.
480	% \sys 读取 Codex 和 Claude Code 本地 JSONL history 及 operation JSONL，并从原生 history 重建 prompt、LLM call 和 tool invocation。AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 记录则先经过源特定 adapter：AgentSight 在声明的 process/tool scope 内连接系统副作用，adapter 输出携带这些连接的 operation；\sys 随后投影并折叠其字段与权重。当前 CLI 不直接读取 AgentSight 记录。
481	
482	\paragraph{Field derivation.}
483	% 字段派生。
484	Production uses first-match regex rules of the form
485	\texttt{KIND:TAG=REGEX}, which developers refine by rerunning \sys and
486	inspecting unmatched operations.
487	% 正则规则是生产环境默认：规则格式为 \texttt{KIND:TAG=REGEX}，按顺序求值（首个匹配胜出）；开发者可以通过重复运行 \sys 并检查未匹配 operation 来细化规则。
488	A local LLM tagger runs a quantized 3B-parameter model through
489	llama.cpp~\cite{llamacpp} to generate a single-word tag or select from a
490	user-declared task-tag set. Both modes use grammar-constrained decoding and
491	caching.
492	% 本地 LLM tagger（例如通过 llama.cpp~\cite{llamacpp} 运行的量化 3B 参数模型）既可生成单词标签，也可从用户声明的 task 标签集合中指派一个标签；两条路径均使用语法约束解码和缓存。
493	TF-IDF~\cite{salton-buckley-1988} and
494	K-Means~\cite{macqueen1967} discover candidate prompt groups without predefined rules,
495	while mapping rules derive fields for structured trajectories, for example
496	\texttt{phase:navigate=type:(click|scroll|key)}.
497	% TF-IDF~\cite{salton-buckley-1988} 和 K-Means~\cite{macqueen1967} 在没有预定义规则时发现候选 prompt 分组，而 mapping rule 为结构化轨迹派生字段，例如 \texttt{phase:navigate=type:(click|scroll|key)}。
498	
499	\paragraph{Boundary construction.}
500	% 边界构建。
501	The Rust inducer counts adjacent action transitions in reference sessions and
502	scores each transition by normalized pointwise mutual information (NPMI),
503	$\mathrm{NPMI}(a,b)=
504	\ln[p(a,b)/(p_L(a)p_R(b))]/-\ln p(a,b)$, with all three probabilities defined
505	over the same transition sample space~\cite{bouma2009npmi}.
506	
507	Occurrence-weighted one-dimensional $k$-means with $k=2$~\cite{macqueen1967}
508	initializes at the minimum and maximum scores, assigns distance ties to the
509	lower center, and uses the converged midpoint as a global cutoff. The inducer
510	applies the same procedure to action-changing transitions for a second cutoff.
511	Same-action pairs use the global cutoff, whereas different-action pairs use the
512	smaller cutoff, so the second cutoff can remove but not add a boundary from the
513	global rule. Unseen or below-cutoff transitions start segments whose
514	run-length-compressed action sequences become stack-frame values. The inducer
515	reads only session identity, input order, and action, not target annotations or
516	resource weights.
517	% Rust inducer 统计参考 session 中的相邻 action 转移，并用 NPMI 评分；所有概率来自同一转移样本空间。按出现次数加权的一维 k-means（k=2）从最小和最大分数初始化，将距离相同的点分到较低中心，并用收敛后两个中心的中点作为全局阈值；在 action-changing occurrence 上进行同样校准得到 cross-action 阈值。相同 action 使用全局阈值，不同 action 使用两者中较小者，因此 refinement 只能删除而不能新增全局规则边界；未见转移或低于应用阈值的分数开始新的 segment。经游程压缩的 action 序列成为 stack-frame value。inducer 只读取 session、输入顺序和 action；评分标签与资源权重不参与构造。
518	
519	An optional reference-calibrated recurrence mode keeps the NPMI score but
520	selects one scalar cutoff that maximizes per-operation B$^3$ F1 on disjoint
521	reference groups. The mode enumerates score intervals, resolves exact ties
522	toward the smallest cutoff, and never reads target groups. Label-free
523	$k$-means remains the default.
524	% 可选的 reference-calibrated recurrence 模式保持同一 NPMI score，并在与目标不重叠的参考分组上选择使每个 operation 等权的 B$^3$ F1 最大的单一阈值。它枚举有限 score interval，在完全平局时选择最小阈值，且不读取目标分组；无标签 k-means 规则仍是默认模式。
525	
526	\paragraph{Profile export.}
527	% Profile 导出。
528	Output formats are pprof protobuf for \texttt{go tool pprof -http}, folded
529	stacks for \texttt{flamegraph.pl}, standalone SVG flame graphs, and JSON.
530	% 输出格式包括 pprof protobuf（兼容 \texttt{go tool pprof -http}）、折叠栈文本（兼容 \texttt{flamegraph.pl}）、独立 SVG 火焰图和 JSON 摘要。
531	
532	%% ===================================================================
533	\section{Evaluation}
534	% 评估
535	\label{sec:eval}
536	
537	\paragraph{Research questions.}
538	% 研究问题。
539	The evaluation addresses four research questions:
540	% 评估回答四个固定的论文级研究问题：
541	\textbf{RQ1:} Does semantic profiling improve resource attribution?
542	\textbf{RQ2:} Does profiler output correspond to real problems?
543	\textbf{RQ3:} How accurate are the tags?
544	\textbf{RQ4:} What is the profiling cost?
545	Each RQ subsection pairs its protocol with the strongest answer its evidence
546	supports.
547	% 后续每个小节都陈述其协议、报告相应证据，并给出该证据所支持的最强答案。
548	
549	We evaluate three data classes separately. \textbf{Real inputs (RQ1)} include
550	325 local histories (198~Codex, 50~Claude, and 77~Claude subagent) with
551	183{,}714 system observations collected over multiple months and a separate
552	20-task controlled capture suite. \textbf{Annotated trajectories (RQ1, RQ3,
553	RQ4)} include 15 real-agent or human web, API, coding, and mobile/GUI execution
554	families mapped into 47{,}590 operations, plus 405 CodeTraceBench
555	trajectories with 20{,}866 operations~\cite{weblinx,mind2web,agenttrek,webshop,
556	apibank,toolbench,taubench,sweagent,androidcontrol,guiodyssey,scalecua,
557	agentrewardbench,safactory,agentnet,osworldhuman}. \textbf{Problem-localization
558	benchmarks (RQ2)} provide independent targets over 27{,}346
559	operations~\cite{agentprocessbench,hintbench,traceelephant}. The RQ4 union
560	contains 27{,}765 operations~\cite{agentrewardbench,safactory,osworldhuman,
561	agentnet}.
562	% 三类数据分开评估：RQ1 使用跨多月收集的真实 history 与独立受控 capture；RQ1/RQ3/RQ4 使用 15 个真实 agent 或 human 的 web、API、coding 与 mobile/GUI execution family 及 CodeTraceBench；RQ2 使用独立问题定位 benchmark；RQ4 使用独立的 27,765-operation union。
563	
564	%% -------------------------------------------------------------------
565	\subsection{RQ1: Resource Attribution}
566	% RQ1：语义分析能否改善资源归因？
567	
568	RQ1 asks whether semantic profiling improves resource attribution beyond what
569	traditional tag-free tools provide.
570	% 我们测试语义标签是否能超越传统无标签工具改善资源归因。
571	
572	\begin{figure*}[t]
573	\centering
574	\includegraphics[width=.90\linewidth]{figures/flamegraph-tokens-paper.png}\\[2pt]
575	\includegraphics[width=.90\linewidth]{figures/flamegraph-time-paper.png}\\[2pt]
576	\includegraphics[width=.90\linewidth]{figures/flamegraph-files-paper.png}
577	\caption{Semantic flame graphs of 325 real agent trajectories. Width represents
578	token count (top), summed per-operation elapsed duration (middle), and the
579	number of file operations (bottom). All three aggregate the same operation
580	corpus and differ only in included operations, stack fields, and the additive
581	width measure.}
582	\Description{Three wide flame graphs showing token budget, time, and
583	file-access distributions across trajectories and prompt categories.}
584	\label{fig:flamegraph}
585	\end{figure*}
586	
587	We first test whether the capture-and-join path assigns system effects within
588	the declared process/tool scope while rejecting concurrent controls. AgentSight
589	0.2.37 captures 20 real Codex tasks, each paired with one concurrent control,
590	and an adapter converts joined effects to operation JSONL for
591	\texttt{agentpprof 0.2.37}.
592	% 我们首先测试捕获与连接路径能否在声明的进程/工具范围内归因系统副作用并拒绝并发对照。评估包含 20 个真实 Codex 任务，每个任务配有一个并发负对照。AgentSight 0.2.37 捕获每一对运行并在该范围内连接副作用；adapter 将连接结果转换为 operation JSONL，再由 \texttt{agentpprof 0.2.37} 折叠。
593	
594	All task and control runs completed. The path recovers 1{,}520/1{,}574 in-scope
595	effects with no false positives (100.0\% precision, 96.569\% recall), rejects
596	all 1{,}629 control effects, and emits 1{,}520 samples in 152 stacks while
597	preserving the input and all five predeclared task-category totals.
598	% 20 个任务及其对照全部完成。连接路径恢复 1,574 个范围内副作用中的 1,520 个，0 个 false positive（precision 100.0\%、recall 96.569\%），且 1,629 个对照副作用均未连接。AgentProf 在 152 个 stack 中输出 1,520 个 sample，并精确保留输入总量及全部五个预先声明任务类别总量。
599	
600	This establishes scoped capture-and-join accuracy and lossless folding with
601	predeclared rather than inferred task categories.
602	% 该结果确立了套件声明进程/工具范围内的捕获与连接精确率和召回率，以及 AgentProf 的无损折叠；任务类别来自预先声明的配置，而非自动任务推断。
603	
604	We next test whether the current operation stack partitions operations into
605	independently annotated responsibility units more faithfully than raw operation
606	identity. We use all 405 failed CodeTraceBench trajectories whose released
607	sources yield the official operation sequence. The population contains
608	20{,}866 operations and 2{,}948 human-verified contiguous stage intervals
609	across OpenHands, mini-SWE-agent, SWE-agent, and
610	Terminus2~\cite{li2026codetracer}.
611	% 接着，我们测试当前 operation stack 是否比 raw operation identity 更准确地将 operation 划分到独立标注的责任单元。我们使用 released source 能生成官方 operation sequence 的全部 405 条失败 CodeTraceBench 轨迹：来自 OpenHands、mini-SWE-agent、SWE-agent 和 Terminus2 的 20,866 个 operation 和 2,948 个人工验证的连续 stage interval。
612	The RQ3 recurrence constructor reads neither target stages nor resource weights.
613	Matched controls start a new group when the raw-action field changes, group by
614	the named phase or action-kind source field, place each session in one group,
615	or make every operation a singleton. Every method receives the same operations
616	and stages.
617	% 我们使用与 RQ3 相同的 recurrence constructor；它不读取目标 stage 或资源权重。匹配的 raw-action grouping 在源 action 字段改变时开始新组；phase-only 与 action-kind grouping 使用同名源字段；session grouping 将每个 session 作为一组；per-operation grouping 将每个 operation 作为单元素组。所有方法接收相同的 operation、stage 和 provider-reported token 测量。
618	
619	We use ordinary operation-level B$^3$ precision, recall, and F1 as the primary
620	metric for partition agreement~\cite{bagga-baldwin-1998-entity-based}.
621	% 我们使用普通 operation-level B$^3$ precision、recall 和 F1 作为标准 partition 指标。
622	
623	\begin{table}[tb]
624	\centering\small
625	\setlength{\tabcolsep}{2.2pt}
626	\begin{tabular}{@{}lrrr@{}}
627	\toprule
628	Method & B$^3$ P & B$^3$ R & B$^3$ F1 \\
629	\midrule
630	Label-free recurrence & 0.829 & 0.534 & 0.649 \\
631	Raw-action grouping & 0.891 & 0.388 & 0.541 \\
632	Phase only & 0.686 & 0.626 & 0.654 \\
633	Action kind & 0.948 & 0.315 & 0.473 \\
634	Per session & 0.174 & 1.000 & 0.296 \\
635	Per operation & 1.000 & 0.141 & 0.248 \\
636	\bottomrule
637	\end{tabular}
638	\caption{RQ1 agreement with human responsibility partitions on 405 CodeTraceBench trajectories.
639	Ordinary B$^3$ is the standard partition-agreement metric.}
640	\label{tab:rq1-attribution}
641	\end{table}
642	
643	Table~\ref{tab:rq1-attribution} shows that recurrence raises ordinary B$^3$ F1
644	over raw action identity from 0.541 to 0.649. The 0.108 gain has a task-clustered
645	paired-bootstrap 95\% interval of [0.087, 0.129] and is positive in all four
646	agent frameworks.
647	% Table~\ref{tab:rq1-attribution} 显示，recurrence 相比 raw action identity 将普通 B$^3$ F1 从 0.541 提升至 0.649。增益为 0.108，paired task-cluster-bootstrap 95\% 置信区间为 [0.087, 0.129]，且在四个 agent framework 中均为正。
648	
649	Phase-only reaches 0.654 ordinary B$^3$ F1, close to recurrence's 0.649.
650	This experiment therefore supports semantic responsibility partitioning over
651	raw action identity, but not recurrence alone or one universally dominant
652	semantic profile. RQ3 separately tests recurrence against phase-only boundaries
653	on OSWorld-Human, where recurrence has a larger advantage. Because this
654	population influenced constructor selection, the result is post-hoc support
655	rather than independent confirmation.
656	% Phase-only 达到 0.654 普通 B$^3$ F1，接近 recurrence 的 0.649。因此，本实验支持 semantic responsibility partitioning 相比 raw action identity 的价值，而不是 recurrence 本身或某个普遍占优的 semantic view。RQ3 在 OSWorld-Human boundary 上单独测试 recurrence constructor 相对 phase-only 的优势。由于该 CodeTraceBench population 曾参与选择当前 constructor，我们将此结果视为 post-hoc supporting evidence，而非 untouched cross-family confirmation。
657	
658	As a separate use case, five declared field hierarchies project the same
659	13{,}265 operations from WebLINX, WebShop, APIBank, AgentTrek, SWE-agent,
660	Mind2Web, ToolBench, AndroidControl, and GUI Odyssey. The profiles contain
661	9~dataset, 57~phase, 226~semantic, 455~action, or 3{,}757~per-session groups.
662	The semantic hierarchy adds task, operation type, tool, and status to dataset
663	and phase, so across these nine datasets the five depths compare budgets by
664	task, repeated actions across sessions, and individual-session details.
665	Separate adapters map all 15 annotated families listed above into the same
666	operation model without type-specific objects.
667	% 作为独立用例，五种声明字段层次投影来自九个数据集的同一批 13,265 个 operation，分别形成 9 个 dataset、57 个 phase、226 个 semantic、455 个 action 或 3,757 个 per-session group。semantic hierarchy 在 dataset 与 phase 之上加入 task、operation type、tool 和 status；五种深度比较按任务统计的预算、跨 session 的重复 action 及单个 session 的细节。这个五深度 sweep 覆盖九个数据集；另有 adapter 将上文全部 15 个标注 family 映射为相同 operation model，无需特定类型对象。
668	
669	Changing only the selection predicate, stack fields, and weight function
670	produces the \texttt{tokens}, \texttt{time}, and \texttt{files} profiles in
671	Figure~\ref{fig:flamegraph}. The \texttt{time} and \texttt{tokens} views of the
672	same 325 trajectories share only 7/10 top prompt categories (Spearman
673	$\rho = 0.623$), while \texttt{network}-tagged prompts rank 8th by time but 93rd by
674	tokens.
675	% 同一 325 个轨迹的 \texttt{time} 和 \texttt{tokens} 视图仅共享 7/10 个顶级 prompt 类别（Spearman $\rho = 0.623$），且 \texttt{network} 标签 prompt 按时间排第 8、按 token 排第 93。
676	Thus, multiple weights expose bottlenecks that one metric would miss.
677	% 因此，多种权重暴露了单一指标会遗漏的瓶颈。
678	Together, RQ1 tests effect lineage through scoped controls, conservation through
679	exact totals, and human-partition agreement through ordinary B$^3$; selectable
680	stacks and weights expose different views over the same operations. RQ3
681	separately evaluates field, group, and boundary construction.
682	% 这些结果共同回答 RQ1：捕获与连接路径拒绝并发对照，AgentProf 保留已归因权重，人工 stage interval 上的标准 partition agreement 表明 semantic attribution 相比 raw action identity 有所改善；可选择的 stack depth 和 weight 从相同 operation 暴露不同的责任与瓶颈视图。RQ3 单独评估 tag 和 group construction accuracy。
683	
684	
685	%% Flamegraph figure appears with the RQ1 multi-weight evidence.
686	
687	%% -------------------------------------------------------------------
688	\subsection{RQ2: Problem Correspondence}
689	% RQ2：分析器输出是否对应真实问题？
690	
691	RQ2 asks whether target-blind profiles place independently annotated problems
692	in groups a developer can inspect early. We run complete AgentProcessBench,
693	HINTBench, and TraceElephant workloads~\cite{agentprocessbench,hintbench,traceelephant}.
694	Of HINTBench's reported 629 trajectories, the released test snapshot used here
695	contains 536. A separate 80-trajectory validation snapshot selects one of 24
696	field orders before all 536 tests are scored.
697	
698	Within each workload, \sys and raw-action grouping use identical operations
699	and the same benchmark-provided judge votes or localizer hits. The two methods
700	differ only in grouping. AgentProcessBench
701	averages judge votes within each group. For HINTBench and TraceElephant, every
702	root-to-frame stack prefix receives the 95\% Wilson lower bound~\cite{wilson1927}
703	of its member hits, and an operation inherits the maximum score among prefixes
704	containing it, with ties preserved.
705	
706	We choose profiles, fields, and scoring rules before revealing independent test
707	targets. Each query is one trajectory containing an annotated target. We report
708	non-interpolated per-query AP, evaluating ties at their shared score threshold,
709	and arithmetic-mean MAP across the 614, 400, and 220 target-bearing
710	queries, respectively~\cite{robertson2008ap}.
711	% RQ2 在完整的 AgentProcessBench、HINTBench 和 TraceElephant workload 上测试 target-blind profile 是否更早排列独立标注的问题。HINTBench 使用独立的 80-trajectory validation snapshot 从 24 个 field order 中选定一个，再评分全部 536 个 test。每个 workload 的 AgentProf 与 raw-action grouping 使用相同 operation 及 benchmark 提供的 judge vote 或 localizer hit，仅 grouping 不同。AgentProcessBench 在组内平均 judge vote；HINTBench 与 TraceElephant 为每个从根到 frame 的 stack prefix 计算成员 hit 的 95% Wilson lower bound，每个 operation 继承包含它的 prefix 中的最大分数并保留并列。profile、field 与 scoring rule 在打开独立 test target 前固定；每条含标注目标的 trajectory 是一个 query，评测每 query 的非插值 average precision（AP）及跨 query 的 mean average precision（MAP）。
712	
713	The post-hoc local-only column ranks operations by the benchmark-provided
714	diagnostic score. Local+semantic and local+raw preserve every
715	strict local-score ordering and use the semantic or raw-action group score only
716	to refine exact ties.
717	
718	\begin{table}[tb]
719	\centering\small
720	\setlength{\tabcolsep}{1.8pt}
721	\begin{tabular}{@{}lrrrrr@{}}
722	\toprule
723	Workload & Sem. & Raw & Local+S & Local+R & Local \\
724	\midrule
725	AgentProcessBench & .789 & .773 & .896 & .893 & .863 \\
726	HINTBench & .452 & .281 & .545 & .506 & .411 \\
727	TraceElephant & .230 & .121 & .322 & .249 & .209 \\
728	\bottomrule
729	\end{tabular}
730	\caption{Standard per-query AP averaged as MAP after scoring every operation.
731	Semantic versus raw action is the primary comparison. Local+semantic,
732	local+raw, and local-only are a post-hoc mechanism analysis on the same
733	complete populations. Higher is better.}
734	\label{tab:rq2-localization}
735	\end{table}
736	
737	In the primary comparison, \sys improves MAP over raw action on all three
738	complete workloads (Table~\ref{tab:rq2-localization}). The gains are +.016
739	[.005,.027], +.171 [.154,.188], and +.109 [.077,.142], using 10{,}000 paired
740	resamples of trajectory clusters within benchmark-defined strata.
741	% AgentProf 在三个完整 workload 的含目标 query 上均提高了相对 matched raw-action organization 的标准主要指标 MAP，因此 RQ2 的答案为肯定。
742	
743	In this post-hoc mechanism analysis, local+semantic MAP is .896/.545/.322,
744	above local-only and semantic-only on all three workloads. Relative to the
745	identically composed local-plus-raw tie-breaker, it gains +.039 [.029,.049] on
746	HINTBench and +.073 [.050,.097] on TraceElephant. AgentProcessBench does not
747	distinguish the two refinements (+.003 [-.0005,.0069]).
748	% 随后的 post-hoc 机制分析复用相同 population：local-first ranking 保留所有严格的 operation-local score 顺序，只在 local score 完全相同时使用 semantic recurrence 排序。其 MAP 为 .896/.545/.322，高于 local-only 的 .863/.411/.209 和 semantic-only 的 .789/.452/.230；相对组成完全相同的 local-plus-raw tie-breaker，它在 HINTBench 和 TraceElephant 上分别提高 +.039 [.029,.049] 与 +.073 [.050,.097]，AgentProcessBench 对两种 refinement 无法区分（+.003 [-.0005,.0069]）。该自适应分析支持“semantic recurrence 细化而不覆盖 local diagnostic evidence”这一简单机制，但不作为未受影响的确认性证据。

\documentclass[letterpaper]{article}

\newcommand{\sys}{\textsc{AgentProf}\xspace}
\newcommand{\operation}{\texttt{operation}\xspace}
\newcommand{\opstack}{\texttt{operation stack}\xspace}
\providecommand{\Description}[1]{}

\begin{document}

\title{\sys: Semantic Profiling for AI Agents}
\author{Anonymous Submission}
\affiliations{}

\maketitle

\begin{abstract}
AI agents orchestrate long-running activities across users, tools, and system
resources, producing growing populations of execution histories.
% AI 智能体编排跨越用户、工具和系统资源的长时间活动，并产生不断增长的执行历史集合。
Developers need population-level answers about where failures concentrate,
which workflows trigger unsafe effects, and which task categories consume the
most budget.
% 开发者需要从群体层面回答故障集中在哪里、哪些工作流触发不安全副作用，以及哪类任务消耗最多预算。
Unlike stable code paths, natural-language intent lacks shared identity, and
native execution nesting does not provide a reusable cross-run hierarchy of
semantic responsibility.
% 与稳定代码路径不同，自然语言意图缺少共享身份，而原生执行嵌套不能提供可跨运行复用的语义责任层次。
Existing agent tools trace runs, group metadata, and aggregate metrics, but do
not combine source-linked system effects, conserved additive measures, and
selectable query-time operation stacks over the same histories.
% 现有 agent 工具可以追踪运行、分组 metadata 并聚合指标，但不会在同一批历史上结合源连接的系统副作用、守恒的可加度量和可选择的查询时 operation stack。
Agent observability needs profiling, not only debugging.
% 智能体可观测性需要 profiling，而不仅仅是 debugging。
\sys realizes this insight through a \emph{semantic operation stack model}
with uniform weighted \emph{operations}, query-time \emph{operation stacks},
pluggable field and stack construction, label-free recurrence over visible
action transitions, and pprof-compatible output.
% \sys 通过语义 operation stack 模型实现这一洞见：统一加权 operation、查询时 operation stack、可插拔字段与栈构造、可见 action transition 上的无标签 recurrence，以及 pprof 兼容输出。
We evaluate \sys on a 20-task real Codex capture suite, 405 human-staged
CodeTraceBench trajectories, three complete public localization benchmarks,
287 OSWorld-Human sessions, and four public cost workloads.
% 我们在 20 个真实 Codex 任务、405 条带人工 stage 的 CodeTraceBench 轨迹、三个完整公开 localization benchmark、287 个 OSWorld-Human session 和四个公开成本 workload 上评估 \sys。
Within the declared process/tool scope, AgentSight capture and joining reach
100.0\% precision and 96.6\% recall, reject 1{,}629/1{,}629 concurrent-control
effects. Label-free recurrence raises ordinary B$^3$ F1 against human stages
from 0.541 to 0.649, and semantic grouping improves MAP over raw action in all
three localization benchmarks.
% 范围化的 AgentSight-to-\sys 路径以 100.0% precision 和 96.6% recall 连接副作用并拒绝全部 1,629 个对照；相对人工 stage partition 的标准 B$^3$ F1 从 0.541 提升至 0.649，semantic grouping 还在三个 localization benchmark 上均提高相对 raw action 的 MAP。
Evaluated task-family and action backends reach 0.695 and 0.498 macro-F1,
label-free recurrence reaches 0.680 boundary F1 and 0.786 B$^3$ F1 on
OSWorld-Human, and \sys constructs a 27{,}765-operation profile in 1.17\,s.
% 评估的 task-family 与 action backend 分别达到 0.695 和 0.498 macro-F1；在 OSWorld-Human 上，无标签 recurrence 达到 0.680 boundary F1 和 0.786 B$^3$ F1；\sys 在 1.17 秒内构建包含 27,765 个 operation 的 profile。
\end{abstract}

% AI agents increasingly orchestrate long-running, multi-step
% activities involving thousands to millions of interactions with
% users, tools, and system resources.
% To optimize the quality, safety, and cost of agents, developers must 
% analyze behaviors across thousands of runs to 
% find where failures concentrate, 
% locate the workflow phases triggering unsafe effects, 
% and identify the tasks that consumes most budget. 

% While performance profiling traditionally answers these questions 
% for classic software by aggregating resource consumption, 
% traditional profilers fail for agents.
% unlike traditional software where code paths provide a natural hierarchy for profiling, 
% agent behaviors are driven by unstructured natural language prompts 
% and lack deterministic execution stacks. 
% To bridge this gap, we propose the Semantic Operation Stack model. 
% First, we unify all heterogeneous agent activities (prompts, tool calls, 
% and system I/O) into a single structured record called an operation. 
% Second, we construct dynamic call stacks at query time by projecting 
% these operations onto user-defined semantic fields (e.g., intent $\rightarrow$ phase $\rightarrow$ action), merging identical sequences to generate flame graphs.

% We implement this model in AgentProf, an offline profiler 
% with pluggable algorithms for intent attribution and stack construction, 
% compiling local agent trajectories into standard, pprof-compatible profiles.

\section{Introduction}
\label{sec:intro}

%% ¶1: Background + context
AI agents~\cite{sweagent,codex,claudecode,osworld} orchestrate multi-step activities
across a high-level intent layer (prompts, LLM calls, and tool invocations) and
a low-level system-effects layer (process spawns and file and network I/O).
% AI 智能体~\cite{sweagent,codex,claudecode,osworld}编排跨越两层的多步骤活动：高层意图（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用）和低层系统副作用（进程创建、文件和网络 I/O）。
As agents evolve from short scripts into complex systems, production teams
accumulate many trajectories.
% 随着智能体从短小脚本发展为复杂系统，生产团队会积累大量轨迹。

%% ¶2: Problem
Developers lack population-level answers about agent quality, safety, and cost.
Which categories of tasks consume the most token budget? Where do
failures concentrate across workflows? Which behavioral patterns
trigger unsafe system effects?
% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨轨迹和交互分析运维行为。哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算？故障跨工作流集中在哪里？哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用？
At scale, manual trajectory inspection is slow and expensive~\cite{agentrewardbench},
while LLM judging requires a separate evaluator pass per
trajectory~\cite{agentrewardbench,llm-as-judge}.
% 在规模化时，人工轨迹检查缓慢且昂贵，而逐轨迹 LLM judging 需要为每次运行单独执行一次 evaluator。

%% ¶3: Structural cause
Agent trajectories lack two structures needed for cross-run profiling.
% 智能体轨迹缺乏使这种聚合成为可能的两个结构。
Responsibility lies in semantic categories such as task intent and tool
operation rather than stable function names. Natural-language prompts provide
no common identifier for shared intent.
% 负责实体是任务意图和工具操作等语义类别而非稳定函数名；自然语言提示词不会为共享意图提供共同标识符。
Native execution nesting may exist, but it does not provide a reusable
cross-run hierarchy of semantic responsibility. A prompt sequence may
represent multiple tasks, while one task may belong to a larger task.
% 原生执行嵌套可以存在，但它不会自动提供可跨运行复用的语义责任层次：一段提示序列可能表示多个任务，而一个任务又可能属于更大的任务。
Thus adapting profiling requires stable semantic identifiers and an
attribution hierarchy that does not depend on a runtime stack.
% 因此，适配 profiling 需要稳定的语义身份，以及不依赖运行时调用栈的归因层次。

%% ¶4: Existing solutions
Existing agent observability lacks this profiling abstraction.
Tools provide rich tracing, metadata aggregation, and population
dashboards~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,datadog-llmobs,laminar-signals},
and some derive hierarchical categories across traces and aggregate latency, cost,
or evaluation metrics~\cite{langsmith-insights,datadog-patterns}, while recent
research canonicalizes actions into process profiles or cross-run graphs for
monitoring and recovery~\cite{traceprobe2026,graphectory2026,webgrapheval2025,
hodoscope2026,tracegraph2026}. These systems establish
semantic grouping, metric rollups, and cross-run analysis. They do not combine
source-linked agent and system effects, conservation of arbitrary additive
measures, and selectable query-time operation stacks over the same histories.
% 现有智能体工具提供 tracing、tag/metadata 聚合和群体级 dashboard；部分工具跨 trace 派生分层类别并聚合 latency、cost 或 evaluation metric，但不会将可加系统副作用连接回负责的 agent action，再按语义字段聚合为可选 pprof profile。

%% ¶5: Model
Agent observability needs profiling, not only debugging.
% 智能体可观测性需要 profiling，而不仅仅是 debugging。
Profiling transfers by projecting resources onto stable semantic tags in an
attribution hierarchy.
% 当资源被投影到负责的语义实体、赋予稳定标签并分层归因时，profiling 方法论可以迁移。
Our \emph{semantic operation stack model} provides this structure through
operations and operation stacks.
% 我们的语义 operation stack 模型通过 operation 和 operation stack 两个组件实现这种迁移。
\emph{Operations} are uniform records with string fields and additive measures
that represent prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations, and system effects
without type-specific objects.
% Operation 是带有字符串字段和可加度量的统一记录，无需特定类型对象即可表示提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用。
\emph{Operation stacks} replace the runtime call stack by ordering selected
fields. Changing those fields attributes the same operations by task category,
execution phase, session, or action type (Figure~\ref{fig:flamegraph}).
% Operation stack 通过排列所选字段替代运行时调用栈；改变这些字段即可按任务类别、执行阶段、会话或操作类型归因同一组 operation（Figure~\ref{fig:flamegraph}）。

%% ¶6: System
We implement this model in \sys, an offline profiler that compiles
local agent trajectories into pprof-compatible profiles~\cite{pprof}
(Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
% 我们在 \sys 中实现此模型，这是一个离线 profiler，将本地智能体轨迹编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile（Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。
\emph{Intent attribution} derives stable, low-cardinality tags from
natural-language fields via regex rules, a local LLM tagger, or unsupervised
clustering, replacing function-name identity.
% 意图归因通过正则规则、本地 LLM 标注器或无监督聚类从自然语言字段派生稳定、低基数的标签，提供传统 profiling 从函数名获得的语义身份。
\emph{Stack construction} uses either selected fields or label-free recurrence
over visible cross-session action transitions to replace runtime nesting.
% 栈构造使用用户指定的字段列表，或学习 reference session 间重复可见 action transition 的无标签 recurrence constructor，在没有运行时调用嵌套时提供层次。

%% ¶7: Results
On 20 real Codex tasks, scoped AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} capture and joining
reach 100.0\% precision and 96.6\% recall.
% 在 20 个真实 Codex 任务上，范围化的 AgentSight capture 与 process/tool join 达到 100.0\% precision 和 96.6\% recall 并拒绝全部 1,629 个对照；adapter 转换后，\sys 在折叠中保留全部 1,520 个已连接副作用。
Across all 405 reconstructable failed CodeTraceBench trajectories~\cite{li2026codetracer},
label-free recurrence raises ordinary B$^3$ F1 against human stages from 0.541
to 0.649 over raw action.
% 在 released source 能生成官方 operation sequence 的全部 405 条失败 CodeTraceBench 轨迹上，recurrence 相比 matched raw action identity 将与人工 stage 的标准 B$^3$ F1 从 0.541 提升至 0.649，增益为 0.108，95\% 区间为 [0.087, 0.129]。
Across three complete public workloads, MAP over target-bearing trajectories
rises from 0.773 to 0.789, 0.281 to 0.452, and 0.121 to 0.230,
respectively~\cite{agentprocessbench,hintbench,traceelephant}.
% 三个完整公开 workload 的全部 27,346 个 operation 均参与评分；在 614/400/220 条含目标 query 上，trajectory MAP 分别从 0.773 提升到 0.789、从 0.281 提升到 0.452、从 0.121 提升到 0.230。
On 287 OSWorld-Human development sessions~\cite{osworldhuman}, label-free
recurrence reaches 0.680 boundary F1 and 0.786 B$^3$ F1. On the AgentBoard and
ASE populations, task-family and action backends reach 0.695 and 0.498
macro-F1, respectively~\cite{agentboard,bouzenia-pradel-2025-trajectories}.
% 在 287 个 OSWorld-Human development session 上，无标签 recurrence 的 boundary F1 与 B$^3$ F1 为 0.680 和 0.786；在 AgentBoard 与 ASE population 上，task-family 与 action backend 分别达到 0.695 和 0.498 macro-F1。
On four public workloads, \sys constructs a 27{,}765-operation profile in
1.17\,s.
% 在四个公开 workload 上，\sys 用 1.17 秒和 464.5 MiB profile 27,765 个 operation，比 raw action 增加 18.2\% 时间和 1.3\% 内存。

This paper makes three contributions:

\begin{enumerate}

  Uniform operations and query-time stacks supply agent observability's

\section{Background and Motivation}
\label{sec:background}

\subsection{LLMs and AI Agents}
% AI 智能体

A typical agent trajectory interleaves two layers of
activity~\cite{sweagent,codex,claudecode,agentsight}.
% 典型的智能体轨迹交织两层活动。
At the intent layer, an agent receives prompts, issues LLM calls, and invokes
tools for code execution, search, and file editing.
% 在意图层，智能体接收用户提示词、发出 LLM 调用并调用工具（代码执行、网络搜索、文件编辑）。
Tool invocations trigger lower-layer process, file, and network
effects~\cite{agentsight}. Trajectories repeat this cycle, and teams accumulate
many trajectories.
% 每次工具调用在下层触发系统副作用：进程创建、文件读写和网络请求。
% 单条轨迹会重复这样的意图-副作用循环，团队也会积累许多轨迹。

\subsection{System Profiling}
% 系统 Profiling

Profiling aggregates measurements to attribute resources to responsible
entities rather than debugging a single execution.
% Profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。
Traditional profilers sample execution, attach each sample to its call stack,
and fold identical stacks~\cite{pprof,flamegraphs}.
% 在传统软件中，profiling 管线如下工作：profiler 周期性采样执行状态，将每个样本附加到当前调用栈，合并具有相同栈的样本。
Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} and pprof~\cite{pprof} call graphs visualize
aggregate cost by width or node size, while Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} queries
trace events and derives new ones.
% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}和 pprof~\cite{pprof} 调用图可视化其结果，宽度或节点大小代表聚合开销。
These tools start from stable code identifiers and runtime stacks, although
pprof can also promote \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} values to pseudo-frames.
% 这些工具通常从稳定的代码标识符和运行时栈开始；pprof 也可以聚合标签，并将 \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} 值提升为伪帧。
Agent profiles must instead derive stable semantic fields and connect them to
downstream effects.
% 智能体轨迹则必须先获得稳定的语义责任字段，并将其连接到下游副作用，之后才能形成这类 profile 视图。

\subsection{Challenges for Agent Profiling}
% 智能体 Profiling 的挑战

Existing tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel} record agent events as
per-execution span trees for single-run debugging.
% 现有工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel}将智能体事件记录为按执行划分的 span 树，有效调试单次运行。
AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} bridges intent and system-effect layers by
correlating extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF) system events with intercepted LLM
traffic, but the resulting recordings still lack aggregate profiling.
% AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 通过关联 eBPF 捕获的系统事件与拦截的 LLM 流量来桥接意图层和系统副作用层，但生成的记录仍缺乏聚合分析能力。


Agent profiling faces two challenges. First, responsibility lies in semantic
categories such as task intent and workflow phase, not code paths.
% 在传统软件中，profiling 将开销归因到代码路径，但在智能体轨迹中，相关实体是语义类别（如任务意图和工作流阶段）。
Standards represent application-supplied span attributes~\cite{otel,
openinference}, but natural-language histories lack stable categories because
different prompts or tools can express the same intent.
% 现有标准可以在 span 中表示应用提供的属性，但自然语言历史不会自动提供稳定的责任类别：表达相同意图的两个提示词和工具调用可能使用不同字符串。

Second, agent trajectories lack a runtime call hierarchy for semantic attribution.
% 第二个挑战是智能体轨迹没有能够自动提供语义归因的运行时调用层次。
In CPU profiling, the stack attributes \texttt{malloc}'s cost simultaneously
to \texttt{parse}, \texttt{process}, and \texttt{main}.
% 在 CPU 分析中，调用栈决定了每个层级的归因：\texttt{malloc} 的开销同时属于 \texttt{parse}、\texttt{process} 和 \texttt{main}。
A prompt sequence may contain one or several tasks within a larger workflow,
yet no runtime mechanism marks its boundaries or attribution granularity.
% 一串提示词可能构成一个任务也可能是多个任务，一个任务可能是更大工作流的一部分，但没有运行时机制标记这些边界或决定在哪个粒度归因开销。
RQ1 evaluates how this missing hierarchy affects attribution, while RQ3
evaluates constructed groups and boundaries.
% RQ1 评估其归因后果，RQ3 评估构造出的 group 与 boundary。

\subsection{Design Requirements for Agent Profiling}
% 智能体 Profiling 的设计需求

Traditional profiling relies on three mechanisms supplied automatically by the call stack.
% 传统 profiling 依赖调用栈自动提供的三种机制。
Agent profiling requires all three without a call stack:
% 智能体 profiling 需要这三种机制，但必须在没有调用栈的情况下实现：

\begin{description}
\item[D1: Cross-layer resource projection.]
The profiler must connect resource consumption from file I/O and process
spawns to the responsible prompts and LLM calls.
% 分析器必须将系统层的资源消耗连接到意图层的语义类别。
\item[D2: Stable tags for folding.]
Without stable function names, the profiler must derive short, repeatable tags
from natural language before folding.
% 智能体提示词是自然语言，因此分析器必须在折叠前派生短小、稳定、可重复的标签。
\item[D3: Hierarchical attribution.]
Because span trees do not encode semantic responsibility through function-call
nesting, the profiler must construct attribution hierarchies from the data.
% 智能体 span 树不通过函数调用嵌套编码语义责任，因此分析器必须从数据中构造归因层次。
\end{description}

\section{Design}
% 设计
\label{sec:design}

The design maps D1--D3 to ingestion, tags, and operation stacks.
% 三个需求（跨层资源投影、稳定标签和分层归因）驱动了设计。
For D1, source-specific ingestion links each system effect to its intent, and
operations preserve inherited semantic fields for projection and folding.
% Source-specific ingestion 与 operation 表示共同满足 D1：ingestion 将系统副作用连接到负责的意图后，operation 保留该连接及继承的语义字段，\sys 随后投影并折叠这些字段。
For D2, intent attribution derives stable tags from natural-language fields.
% Attribution and Stack Construction 中的意图归因通过从自然语言字段派生稳定标签满足 D2。
For D3, \emph{operation stacks} replace runtime stacks with query-time field
projections, supporting multiple attribution granularities over the same data.
% Operation stack 通过以查询时字段投影替代运行时调用栈，在多个粒度层级归因资源来满足 D3，使同一数据支持多种视图而无需重建输入。

The profiling pipeline has four stages: (1)~parse raw trajectories into operations, (2)~enrich operations via intent attribution or mapping rules, (3)~project each operation onto a stack frame sequence chosen at query time, and (4)~fold operations with identical stacks, summing their weights.
% 分析管线有四个阶段：(1) 将原始轨迹解析为 operation，(2) 通过意图归因或映射规则丰富 operation，(3) 将每个 operation 投影到查询时选择的栈帧序列上，(4) 折叠具有相同栈的 operation 并求和权重。
