\subsection{Semantic Operation Stack Model}
% 语义 Operation Stack 模型
\label{sec:ops}

%% ¶1: Operations
\sys represents each activity from the intent and system-effect layers as an
\operation, a weighted record with string fields and additive measures.
% 由于智能体活动跨越 Background and Motivation 中描述的意图层和系统副作用层，分析器不应在数据表示层面区分它们。
% 因此 \sys 将每个活动表示为单一抽象——operation，一个带有字符串字段和可加度量的加权记录。
Each operation carries string fields (\texttt{project},
\texttt{agent}, \texttt{session}, \texttt{prompt\_tag},
\texttt{kind}, \texttt{model}, \texttt{path}, \texttt{domain},
\texttt{status}, \ldots) and additive measures (token count,
duration, event count).
% 每个 operation 携带字符串字段（\texttt{project}、\texttt{agent}、\texttt{session}、\texttt{prompt\_tag}、\texttt{kind}、\texttt{model}、\texttt{path}、\texttt{domain}、\texttt{status} 等）和可加度量（token 数、持续时间、事件数）。
The same schema represents prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations, file reads,
GUI clicks, and process events. Populated fields distinguish these operation
types.
% 提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用、文件读取、GUI 点击和进程事件都是具有相同 schema 的 operation，仅通过哪些字段有值来区分。
When a tool invocation triggers system effects, ingestion propagates its
semantic fields to the resulting operations, allowing downstream resource
weights to fold under the responsible intent.
% 当工具调用触发系统副作用时，输入处理将其语义字段传播到生成的 operation，使下游资源权重能够折叠到负责的意图之下。

%% ¶2: Operation Stacks
\label{sec:stacks}
An \opstack replaces the runtime call stack to provide hierarchical attribution
for agent trajectories.
% 一个 operation stack 为智能体轨迹提供分层归因，替代运行时调用栈。
In CPU profiling, a call stack determines which code paths
share responsibility for a resource cost.
% 在 CPU 分析中，调用栈决定哪些代码路径共同承担资源开销。
In \sys, an ordered list of fields
$[f_1, f_2, \ldots, f_k]$ projects each operation $o$ to a frame
sequence $\langle o.f_1, o.f_2, \ldots, o.f_k \rangle$, and
operations with identical sequences are merged, summing their
weights.
% Operation stack 承担相同角色：有序字段列表 $[f_1, f_2, \ldots, f_k]$ 将每个 operation $o$ 投影到帧序列 $\langle o.f_1, o.f_2, \ldots, o.f_k \rangle$，具有相同序列的 operation 被合并，权重求和。
Unlike a call stack, the fields are chosen at query time, not
determined by execution.
% 与调用栈不同，字段在查询时选择，而非由执行决定。
The same operations can therefore support a flat task summary, a per-session
tree, a semantic phase/action hierarchy, or a trajectory organized by the
dataset's own annotations. Field selection changes attribution but not the data.
% 因此同一组 operation 可归因为扁平任务摘要、固定会话树、语义阶段/操作层次或使用数据集自身标注的轨迹，改变字段即改变归因方式而无需改变数据。
Sessions and spans are optional fields, not hierarchy levels. The same data
supports debugging views with \texttt{session} and aggregate profiling views
without that field.
% 会话和 span 是可选的 operation 字段而非固定层次级别，因此同一数据既支持调试视图（包含 \texttt{session}）也支持聚合 profiling 视图（排除它）。

We formalize each selectable profile as a view $(\varphi, \sigma, w)$. For operation $o$, the predicate
$\varphi(o)$ decides inclusion, an ordered field list
$[f_1, \ldots, f_k]$ defines
$\sigma(o)=\langle o.f_1, \ldots, o.f_k \rangle$, and $w(o)\geq0$ supplies its
weight.
% 一个视图是三元组 $(\varphi, \sigma, w)$：谓词 $\varphi$ 选择参与的 operation，栈函数 $\sigma = [f_1, \ldots, f_k]$ 将每个 operation 映射到其帧序列，权重函数 $w$ 赋予非负度量。
Users choose the stack function independently of the predicate and weight
function. Four built-in resource
choices define $\varphi$ and $w$ for common questions: (1)~\texttt{tokens} weights LLM
calls by token count, (2)~\texttt{time} weights timed operations by duration,
(3)~\texttt{files} weights file operations by event count, and
(4)~\texttt{network} weights network operations by event count.
% 栈函数保持独立可选。四个内置资源选择为常见问题定义 $\varphi$ 和 $w$：\texttt{tokens}（LLM 调用按 token 数加权）、\texttt{time}（所有计时操作按时长加权）、\texttt{files}（文件操作按事件数加权）和 \texttt{network}（网络操作按事件数加权）。

\subsection{Attribution and Stack Construction}
% 归因与栈构造
\label{sec:intent}

\paragraph{Intent attribution.}
% 意图归因。
Intent attribution maps natural-language fields to short, stable, repeatable
tags, supplying the identifiers that traditional profiling obtains from
function names.
% 意图归因将自然语言的提示词映射为短小、稳定、可重复的标签，为智能体轨迹提供传统 profiling 从函数名免费获得的稳定标识符，详见 Background and Motivation。
The framework supports three pluggable backends.
% 该框架支持三种可插拔后端。
Explicit rules provide repeatable user control, a local model tags
natural-language fields, and unsupervised grouping discovers candidate
categories that developers can encode as rules.
% 显式规则提供可重复的用户控制，本地模型标注自然语言字段，无监督分组帮助发现供后续规则编写使用的候选类别。
Structured trajectories use the same interface to derive fields from existing
action and quality attributes.
% 结构化轨迹使用同一接口从现有 action 和质量属性派生字段。
All backends emit ordinary operation fields, keeping the stack model
independent of how a tag was obtained.
% 所有 backend 都输出普通 operation 字段，使 stack 模型独立于标签的获取方式。

\paragraph{Stack construction.}
% 栈构造。
With an ordered field list, stack construction directly projects the available
fields.
% 当用户提供有序字段列表时，投影是直接的。
When users enable automatic construction, \sys induces operation stacks
without a user-specified field list through \emph{label-free recurrence}.
Visible actions are action-field values available before target annotations
are read. The constructor uses adjacent visible-action recurrence across
reference sessions, so weak or unseen transitions start segments and recurring
transitions continue them. Each segment's run-length-compressed action sequence
becomes a reusable stack-frame value.
% 它学习哪些相邻可见 action 会在参考 session 中稳定重复。较弱或未见过的转移开始新的 segment；重复出现的转移延续当前 segment，其经游程压缩的 action 序列成为可复用的 stack-frame value。
The derived group and stack-frame values are ordinary operation fields, so the stack
function can compose them with task, phase, action, or session fields at query
time.
% 派生出的 group 与 stack-frame value 是普通 operation 字段，因此栈函数可在查询时将其与 task、phase、action 或 session 字段组合。
The constructor can learn from a separate label-free operation corpus, so it
does not use the target session's problem annotations.
% 参考数据可以是独立的无标签 operation 语料，因此构造过程不使用目标 session 的问题标注。

%% ===================================================================
\section{Implementation}
% 实现
\label{sec:impl}

\sys is an approximately 9.8K-line offline Rust command-line interface that
implements the semantic operation stack model (Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
% \sys 将 operation 和 stack 模型实现为离线 Rust CLI（约 9.8K 行代码，Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。

\paragraph{Input reconstruction.}
% 输入重建。
\sys reads Codex and Claude Code local JSON Lines (JSONL) histories and
operation JSONL.
For native histories, it reconstructs prompts, LLM calls, and tool invocations.
Because the current CLI does not read AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} recordings
directly, those recordings pass through a source-specific adapter. For
AgentSight recordings, the declared process/tool scope contains the captured
target agent process and its launched tool command, excluding concurrent
control activity. AgentSight joins system effects within this scope, and the
adapter emits operations carrying those links.
\sys then projects and folds their fields and weights.
% \sys 读取 Codex 和 Claude Code 本地 JSONL history 及 operation JSONL，并从原生 history 重建 prompt、LLM call 和 tool invocation。AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 记录则先经过源特定 adapter：AgentSight 在声明的 process/tool scope 内连接系统副作用，adapter 输出携带这些连接的 operation；\sys 随后投影并折叠其字段与权重。当前 CLI 不直接读取 AgentSight 记录。

\paragraph{Field derivation.}
% 字段派生。
Production uses first-match regex rules of the form
\texttt{KIND:TAG=REGEX}, which developers refine by rerunning \sys and
inspecting unmatched operations.
% 正则规则是生产环境默认：规则格式为 \texttt{KIND:TAG=REGEX}，按顺序求值（首个匹配胜出）；开发者可以通过重复运行 \sys 并检查未匹配 operation 来细化规则。
A local LLM tagger runs a quantized 3B-parameter model through
llama.cpp~\cite{llamacpp} to generate a single-word tag or select from a
user-declared task-tag set. Both modes use grammar-constrained decoding and
caching.
% 本地 LLM tagger（例如通过 llama.cpp~\cite{llamacpp} 运行的量化 3B 参数模型）既可生成单词标签，也可从用户声明的 task 标签集合中指派一个标签；两条路径均使用语法约束解码和缓存。
TF-IDF~\cite{salton-buckley-1988} and
K-Means~\cite{macqueen1967} discover candidate prompt groups without predefined rules,
while mapping rules derive fields for structured trajectories, for example
\texttt{phase:navigate=type:(click|scroll|key)}.
% TF-IDF~\cite{salton-buckley-1988} 和 K-Means~\cite{macqueen1967} 在没有预定义规则时发现候选 prompt 分组，而 mapping rule 为结构化轨迹派生字段，例如 \texttt{phase:navigate=type:(click|scroll|key)}。

\paragraph{Boundary construction.}
% 边界构建。
The Rust inducer counts adjacent action transitions in reference sessions and
scores each transition by normalized pointwise mutual information (NPMI),
$\mathrm{NPMI}(a,b)=
\ln[p(a,b)/(p_L(a)p_R(b))]/-\ln p(a,b)$, with all three probabilities defined
over the same transition sample space~\cite{bouma2009npmi}.

Occurrence-weighted one-dimensional $k$-means with $k=2$~\cite{macqueen1967}
initializes at the minimum and maximum scores, assigns distance ties to the
lower center, and uses the converged midpoint as a global cutoff. The inducer
applies the same procedure to action-changing transitions for a second cutoff.
Same-action pairs use the global cutoff, whereas different-action pairs use the
smaller cutoff, so the second cutoff can remove but not add a boundary from the
global rule. Unseen or below-cutoff transitions start segments whose
run-length-compressed action sequences become stack-frame values. The inducer
reads only session identity, input order, and action, not target annotations or
resource weights.
% Rust inducer 统计参考 session 中的相邻 action 转移，并用 NPMI 评分；所有概率来自同一转移样本空间。按出现次数加权的一维 k-means（k=2）从最小和最大分数初始化，将距离相同的点分到较低中心，并用收敛后两个中心的中点作为全局阈值；在 action-changing occurrence 上进行同样校准得到 cross-action 阈值。相同 action 使用全局阈值，不同 action 使用两者中较小者，因此 refinement 只能删除而不能新增全局规则边界；未见转移或低于应用阈值的分数开始新的 segment。经游程压缩的 action 序列成为 stack-frame value。inducer 只读取 session、输入顺序和 action；评分标签与资源权重不参与构造。

An optional reference-calibrated recurrence mode keeps the NPMI score but
selects one scalar cutoff that maximizes per-operation B$^3$ F1 on disjoint
reference groups. The mode enumerates score intervals, resolves exact ties
toward the smallest cutoff, and never reads target groups. Label-free
$k$-means remains the default.
% 可选的 reference-calibrated recurrence 模式保持同一 NPMI score，并在与目标不重叠的参考分组上选择使每个 operation 等权的 B$^3$ F1 最大的单一阈值。它枚举有限 score interval，在完全平局时选择最小阈值，且不读取目标分组；无标签 k-means 规则仍是默认模式。

\paragraph{Profile export.}
% Profile 导出。
Output formats are pprof protobuf for \texttt{go tool pprof -http}, folded
stacks for \texttt{flamegraph.pl}, standalone SVG flame graphs, and JSON.
% 输出格式包括 pprof protobuf（兼容 \texttt{go tool pprof -http}）、折叠栈文本（兼容 \texttt{flamegraph.pl}）、独立 SVG 火焰图和 JSON 摘要。

%% ===================================================================
\section{Evaluation}
% 评估
\label{sec:eval}

\paragraph{Research questions.}
% 研究问题。
The evaluation addresses four research questions:
% 评估回答四个固定的论文级研究问题：
\textbf{RQ1:} Does semantic profiling improve resource attribution?
\textbf{RQ2:} Does profiler output correspond to real problems?
\textbf{RQ3:} How accurate are the tags?
\textbf{RQ4:} What is the profiling cost?
Each RQ subsection pairs its protocol with the strongest answer its evidence
supports.
% 后续每个小节都陈述其协议、报告相应证据，并给出该证据所支持的最强答案。

We evaluate three data classes separately. \textbf{Real inputs (RQ1)} include
325 local histories (198~Codex, 50~Claude, and 77~Claude subagent) with
183{,}714 system observations collected over multiple months and a separate
20-task controlled capture suite. \textbf{Annotated trajectories (RQ1, RQ3,
RQ4)} include 15 real-agent or human web, API, coding, and mobile/GUI execution
families mapped into 47{,}590 operations, plus 405 CodeTraceBench
trajectories with 20{,}866 operations~\cite{weblinx,mind2web,agenttrek,webshop,
apibank,toolbench,taubench,sweagent,androidcontrol,guiodyssey,scalecua,
agentrewardbench,safactory,agentnet,osworldhuman}. \textbf{Problem-localization
benchmarks (RQ2)} provide independent targets over 27{,}346
operations~\cite{agentprocessbench,hintbench,traceelephant}. The RQ4 union
contains 27{,}765 operations~\cite{agentrewardbench,safactory,osworldhuman,
agentnet}.
% 三类数据分开评估：RQ1 使用跨多月收集的真实 history 与独立受控 capture；RQ1/RQ3/RQ4 使用 15 个真实 agent 或 human 的 web、API、coding 与 mobile/GUI execution family 及 CodeTraceBench；RQ2 使用独立问题定位 benchmark；RQ4 使用独立的 27,765-operation union。

%% -------------------------------------------------------------------
\subsection{RQ1: Resource Attribution}
% RQ1：语义分析能否改善资源归因？

RQ1 asks whether semantic profiling improves resource attribution beyond what
traditional tag-free tools provide.
% 我们测试语义标签是否能超越传统无标签工具改善资源归因。

\begin{figure*}[t]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=.90\linewidth]{figures/flamegraph-tokens-paper.png}\\[2pt]
\includegraphics[width=.90\linewidth]{figures/flamegraph-time-paper.png}\\[2pt]
\includegraphics[width=.90\linewidth]{figures/flamegraph-files-paper.png}
\caption{Semantic flame graphs of 325 real agent trajectories. Width represents
token count (top), summed per-operation elapsed duration (middle), and the
number of file operations (bottom). All three aggregate the same operation
corpus and differ only in included operations, stack fields, and the additive
width measure.}
\Description{Three wide flame graphs showing token budget, time, and
file-access distributions across trajectories and prompt categories.}
\label{fig:flamegraph}
\end{figure*}

We first test whether the capture-and-join path assigns system effects within
the declared process/tool scope while rejecting concurrent controls. AgentSight
0.2.37 captures 20 real Codex tasks, each paired with one concurrent control,
and an adapter converts joined effects to operation JSONL for
\texttt{agentpprof 0.2.37}.
% 我们首先测试捕获与连接路径能否在声明的进程/工具范围内归因系统副作用并拒绝并发对照。评估包含 20 个真实 Codex 任务，每个任务配有一个并发负对照。AgentSight 0.2.37 捕获每一对运行并在该范围内连接副作用；adapter 将连接结果转换为 operation JSONL，再由 \texttt{agentpprof 0.2.37} 折叠。

All task and control runs completed. The path recovers 1{,}520/1{,}574 in-scope
effects with no false positives (100.0\% precision, 96.569\% recall), rejects
all 1{,}629 control effects, and emits 1{,}520 samples in 152 stacks while
preserving the input and all five predeclared task-category totals.
% 20 个任务及其对照全部完成。连接路径恢复 1,574 个范围内副作用中的 1,520 个，0 个 false positive（precision 100.0\%、recall 96.569\%），且 1,629 个对照副作用均未连接。AgentProf 在 152 个 stack 中输出 1,520 个 sample，并精确保留输入总量及全部五个预先声明任务类别总量。

This establishes scoped capture-and-join accuracy and lossless folding with
predeclared rather than inferred task categories.
% 该结果确立了套件声明进程/工具范围内的捕获与连接精确率和召回率，以及 AgentProf 的无损折叠；任务类别来自预先声明的配置，而非自动任务推断。

We next test whether the current operation stack partitions operations into
independently annotated responsibility units more faithfully than raw operation
identity. We use all 405 failed CodeTraceBench trajectories whose released
sources yield the official operation sequence. The population contains
20{,}866 operations and 2{,}948 human-verified contiguous stage intervals
across OpenHands, mini-SWE-agent, SWE-agent, and
Terminus2~\cite{li2026codetracer}.
% 接着，我们测试当前 operation stack 是否比 raw operation identity 更准确地将 operation 划分到独立标注的责任单元。我们使用 released source 能生成官方 operation sequence 的全部 405 条失败 CodeTraceBench 轨迹：来自 OpenHands、mini-SWE-agent、SWE-agent 和 Terminus2 的 20,866 个 operation 和 2,948 个人工验证的连续 stage interval。
The RQ3 recurrence constructor reads neither target stages nor resource weights.
Matched controls start a new group when the raw-action field changes, group by
the named phase or action-kind source field, place each session in one group,
or make every operation a singleton. Every method receives the same operations
and stages.
% 我们使用与 RQ3 相同的 recurrence constructor；它不读取目标 stage 或资源权重。匹配的 raw-action grouping 在源 action 字段改变时开始新组；phase-only 与 action-kind grouping 使用同名源字段；session grouping 将每个 session 作为一组；per-operation grouping 将每个 operation 作为单元素组。所有方法接收相同的 operation、stage 和 provider-reported token 测量。

We use ordinary operation-level B$^3$ precision, recall, and F1 as the primary
metric for partition agreement~\cite{bagga-baldwin-1998-entity-based}.
% 我们使用普通 operation-level B$^3$ precision、recall 和 F1 作为标准 partition 指标。

\begin{table}[tb]
\centering\small
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{2.2pt}
\begin{tabular}{@{}lrrr@{}}
\toprule
Method & B$^3$ P & B$^3$ R & B$^3$ F1 \\
\midrule
Label-free recurrence & 0.829 & 0.534 & 0.649 \\
Raw-action grouping & 0.891 & 0.388 & 0.541 \\
Phase only & 0.686 & 0.626 & 0.654 \\
Action kind & 0.948 & 0.315 & 0.473 \\
Per session & 0.174 & 1.000 & 0.296 \\
Per operation & 1.000 & 0.141 & 0.248 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\caption{RQ1 agreement with human responsibility partitions on 405 CodeTraceBench trajectories.
Ordinary B$^3$ is the standard partition-agreement metric.}
\label{tab:rq1-attribution}
\end{table}

Table~\ref{tab:rq1-attribution} shows that recurrence raises ordinary B$^3$ F1
over raw action identity from 0.541 to 0.649. The 0.108 gain has a task-clustered
paired-bootstrap 95\% interval of [0.087, 0.129] and is positive in all four
agent frameworks.
% Table~\ref{tab:rq1-attribution} 显示，recurrence 相比 raw action identity 将普通 B$^3$ F1 从 0.541 提升至 0.649。增益为 0.108，paired task-cluster-bootstrap 95\% 置信区间为 [0.087, 0.129]，且在四个 agent framework 中均为正。

Phase-only reaches 0.654 ordinary B$^3$ F1, close to recurrence's 0.649.
This experiment therefore supports semantic responsibility partitioning over
raw action identity, but not recurrence alone or one universally dominant
semantic profile. RQ3 separately tests recurrence against phase-only boundaries
on OSWorld-Human, where recurrence has a larger advantage. Because this
population influenced constructor selection, the result is post-hoc support
rather than independent confirmation.
% Phase-only 达到 0.654 普通 B$^3$ F1，接近 recurrence 的 0.649。因此，本实验支持 semantic responsibility partitioning 相比 raw action identity 的价值，而不是 recurrence 本身或某个普遍占优的 semantic view。RQ3 在 OSWorld-Human boundary 上单独测试 recurrence constructor 相对 phase-only 的优势。由于该 CodeTraceBench population 曾参与选择当前 constructor，我们将此结果视为 post-hoc supporting evidence，而非 untouched cross-family confirmation。

As a separate use case, five declared field hierarchies project the same
13{,}265 operations from WebLINX, WebShop, APIBank, AgentTrek, SWE-agent,
Mind2Web, ToolBench, AndroidControl, and GUI Odyssey. The profiles contain
9~dataset, 57~phase, 226~semantic, 455~action, or 3{,}757~per-session groups.
The semantic hierarchy adds task, operation type, tool, and status to dataset
and phase, so across these nine datasets the five depths compare budgets by
task, repeated actions across sessions, and individual-session details.
Separate adapters map all 15 annotated families listed above into the same
operation model without type-specific objects.
% 作为独立用例，五种声明字段层次投影来自九个数据集的同一批 13,265 个 operation，分别形成 9 个 dataset、57 个 phase、226 个 semantic、455 个 action 或 3,757 个 per-session group。semantic hierarchy 在 dataset 与 phase 之上加入 task、operation type、tool 和 status；五种深度比较按任务统计的预算、跨 session 的重复 action 及单个 session 的细节。这个五深度 sweep 覆盖九个数据集；另有 adapter 将上文全部 15 个标注 family 映射为相同 operation model，无需特定类型对象。

Changing only the selection predicate, stack fields, and weight function
produces the \texttt{tokens}, \texttt{time}, and \texttt{files} profiles in
Figure~\ref{fig:flamegraph}. The \texttt{time} and \texttt{tokens} views of the
same 325 trajectories share only 7/10 top prompt categories (Spearman
$\rho = 0.623$), while \texttt{network}-tagged prompts rank 8th by time but 93rd by
tokens.
% 同一 325 个轨迹的 \texttt{time} 和 \texttt{tokens} 视图仅共享 7/10 个顶级 prompt 类别（Spearman $\rho = 0.623$），且 \texttt{network} 标签 prompt 按时间排第 8、按 token 排第 93。
Thus, multiple weights expose bottlenecks that one metric would miss.
% 因此，多种权重暴露了单一指标会遗漏的瓶颈。
Together, RQ1 tests effect lineage through scoped controls, conservation through
exact totals, and human-partition agreement through ordinary B$^3$; selectable
stacks and weights expose different views over the same operations. RQ3
separately evaluates field, group, and boundary construction.
% 这些结果共同回答 RQ1：捕获与连接路径拒绝并发对照，AgentProf 保留已归因权重，人工 stage interval 上的标准 partition agreement 表明 semantic attribution 相比 raw action identity 有所改善；可选择的 stack depth 和 weight 从相同 operation 暴露不同的责任与瓶颈视图。RQ3 单独评估 tag 和 group construction accuracy。


%% Flamegraph figure appears with the RQ1 multi-weight evidence.

%% -------------------------------------------------------------------
\subsection{RQ2: Problem Correspondence}
% RQ2：分析器输出是否对应真实问题？

RQ2 asks whether target-blind profiles place independently annotated problems
in groups a developer can inspect early. We run complete AgentProcessBench,
HINTBench, and TraceElephant workloads~\cite{agentprocessbench,hintbench,traceelephant}.
Of HINTBench's reported 629 trajectories, the released test snapshot used here
contains 536. A separate 80-trajectory validation snapshot selects one of 24
field orders before all 536 tests are scored.

Within each workload, \sys and raw-action grouping use identical operations
and the same benchmark-provided judge votes or localizer hits. The two methods
differ only in grouping. AgentProcessBench
averages judge votes within each group. For HINTBench and TraceElephant, every
root-to-frame stack prefix receives the 95\% Wilson lower bound~\cite{wilson1927}
of its member hits, and an operation inherits the maximum score among prefixes
containing it, with ties preserved.

We choose profiles, fields, and scoring rules before revealing independent test
targets. Each query is one trajectory containing an annotated target. We report
non-interpolated per-query AP, evaluating ties at their shared score threshold,
and arithmetic-mean MAP across the 614, 400, and 220 target-bearing
queries, respectively~\cite{robertson2008ap}.
% RQ2 在完整的 AgentProcessBench、HINTBench 和 TraceElephant workload 上测试 target-blind profile 是否更早排列独立标注的问题。HINTBench 使用独立的 80-trajectory validation snapshot 从 24 个 field order 中选定一个，再评分全部 536 个 test。每个 workload 的 AgentProf 与 raw-action grouping 使用相同 operation 及 benchmark 提供的 judge vote 或 localizer hit，仅 grouping 不同。AgentProcessBench 在组内平均 judge vote；HINTBench 与 TraceElephant 为每个从根到 frame 的 stack prefix 计算成员 hit 的 95% Wilson lower bound，每个 operation 继承包含它的 prefix 中的最大分数并保留并列。profile、field 与 scoring rule 在打开独立 test target 前固定；每条含标注目标的 trajectory 是一个 query，评测每 query 的非插值 average precision（AP）及跨 query 的 mean average precision（MAP）。

The post-hoc local-only column ranks operations by the benchmark-provided
diagnostic score. Local+semantic and local+raw preserve every
strict local-score ordering and use the semantic or raw-action group score only
to refine exact ties.

\begin{table}[tb]
\centering\small
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{1.8pt}
\begin{tabular}{@{}lrrrrr@{}}
\toprule
Workload & Sem. & Raw & Local+S & Local+R & Local \\
\midrule
AgentProcessBench & .789 & .773 & .896 & .893 & .863 \\
HINTBench & .452 & .281 & .545 & .506 & .411 \\
TraceElephant & .230 & .121 & .322 & .249 & .209 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\caption{Standard per-query AP averaged as MAP after scoring every operation.
Semantic versus raw action is the primary comparison. Local+semantic,
local+raw, and local-only are a post-hoc mechanism analysis on the same
complete populations. Higher is better.}
\label{tab:rq2-localization}
\end{table}

In the primary comparison, \sys improves MAP over raw action on all three
complete workloads (Table~\ref{tab:rq2-localization}). The gains are +.016
[.005,.027], +.171 [.154,.188], and +.109 [.077,.142], using 10{,}000 paired
resamples of trajectory clusters within benchmark-defined strata.
% AgentProf 在三个完整 workload 的含目标 query 上均提高了相对 matched raw-action organization 的标准主要指标 MAP，因此 RQ2 的答案为肯定。

In this post-hoc mechanism analysis, local+semantic MAP is .896/.545/.322,
above local-only and semantic-only on all three workloads. Relative to the
identically composed local-plus-raw tie-breaker, it gains +.039 [.029,.049] on
HINTBench and +.073 [.050,.097] on TraceElephant. AgentProcessBench does not
distinguish the two refinements (+.003 [-.0005,.0069]).
% 随后的 post-hoc 机制分析复用相同 population：local-first ranking 保留所有严格的 operation-local score 顺序，只在 local score 完全相同时使用 semantic recurrence 排序。其 MAP 为 .896/.545/.322，高于 local-only 的 .863/.411/.209 和 semantic-only 的 .789/.452/.230；相对组成完全相同的 local-plus-raw tie-breaker，它在 HINTBench 和 TraceElephant 上分别提高 +.039 [.029,.049] 与 +.073 [.050,.097]，AgentProcessBench 对两种 refinement 无法区分（+.003 [-.0005,.0069]）。该自适应分析支持“semantic recurrence 细化而不覆盖 local diagnostic evidence”这一简单机制，但不作为未受影响的确认性证据。

949	% 相关工作
950	
951	\textbf{Agent observability.}
952	Platforms aggregate spans, metadata, and evaluations~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,
953	otel,datadog-llmobs}. Datadog Patterns and LangSmith Insights derive
954	cross-trace hierarchies and roll up metrics, NeMo profiles instrumented
955	workflows, and OpenTelemetry Profiles links profiles to traces~\cite{datadog-patterns,
956	langsmith-insights,nemo-agent-toolkit-profiler,otel-profiles}. These establish
957	grouping, rollups, profile naming and compatibility, and trace linkage. \sys's
958	residual capability is their conjunction in one operation corpus: joining agent
959	actions to process, file, and network effects while conserving arbitrary
960	additive measures and supporting selectable query-time field stacks.

964	TraceProbe supplies resource-aware process profiles, while Graphectory builds
965	per-trajectory process graphs with aggregated phase patterns~\cite{traceprobe2026,
966	graphectory2026}.
967	Hodoscope compares
968	behavior distributions to direct human review, while TraceGraph builds shared
969	decision landscapes that guide recovery~\cite{hodoscope2026,tracegraph2026}.
970	Together, these systems establish canonical actions, recurring cross-run
971	structure, and analysis-to-decision precedents. \sys complements them with
972	source-linked heterogeneous effects, conservation of user-selected additive
973	measures, and multiple operation-stack projections over the same histories.
974	
975	\textbf{Profiling and diagnosis.}
976	pprof and flame graphs fold runtime stacks, whereas Perfetto queries trace
977	events~\cite{pprof,flamegraphs,perfetto}. AgentRx diagnoses failures,
978	CodeTracer reconstructs per-run states, and localization benchmarks score
979	faulty steps, agents, or expert-supported perspectives~\cite{agentrx,
980	li2026codetracer,agentprocessbench,hintbench,traceelephant,mpbench2026}.
981	\sys applies the profiler's population-level principle
982	to agents by treating completed trajectories as samples and using query-time
983	operation stacks to fold recurring semantic responsibility without code
984	identity or runtime nesting.
985	% AgentRx 诊断执行失败，CodeTracer 重建层次化状态转移以支持定位与 replay；AgentProcessBench、HINTBench 和 TraceElephant 衡量方法是否识别故障 step 或 agent。\sys 回答互补的群体问题：哪些重复语义责任在跨轨迹中累积资源使用或问题，并将其表示为聚合 profile 而非另一种单次运行诊断。

989	% 结论
990	
991	Agent observability needs profiling, not only debugging. \sys represents
992	heterogeneous agent actions and system effects as weighted operations and folds
993	selectable query-time operation stacks across runs. On complete real and public
994	workloads, its profiles preserve linked
995	effects, improve human-stage partition agreement and problem-localization MAP
996	over raw action, and recover OSWorld-Human groups at 0.680 boundary F1 and
997	0.786 B$^3$ F1. A 27{,}765-operation profile builds in 1.17 seconds, making
998	population-level profiling a practical complement to per-run debugging.

\toprule
Method & Prec. & Recall & Bound. F1 & B$^3$ F1 \\
\midrule
Supervised predictor & 0.700 & 0.782 & \textbf{0.739} & \textbf{0.816} \\
Reference-calibrated recurrence & 0.610 & 0.922 & 0.734 & 0.801 \\
Label-free recurrence & 0.592 & 0.799 & 0.680 & 0.786 \\
Always boundary & 0.476 & 1.000 & 0.645 & 0.678 \\
Action change & 0.386 & 0.626 & 0.477 & 0.659 \\
Phase change & 0.441 & 0.268 & 0.334 & 0.665 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\caption{RQ3 boundary and partition agreement on OSWorld-Human. Boundary F1 scores
exact adjacent-pair decisions. B$^3$ scores predicted--human partitions.}
\label{tab:rq3-boundary}
\end{table}

The supervised predictor reaches 0.739 boundary F1 and 0.816 B$^3$ F1 versus
0.645 and 0.678 for the strongest controls. Label-free recurrence reaches
0.680 and 0.786, while reference-calibrated recurrence reaches 0.734 and 0.801
but requires group annotations that the default label-free method does not use.
Every method conserves the total projected weight.
% 监督 predictor 的 boundary 与 B$^3$ F1 为 0.739 和 0.816，最强对照为 0.645 和 0.678；无标签 recurrence 为 0.680 和 0.786；使用额外 group 标注的 reference calibration 为 0.734 和 0.801。所有投影权重均保持守恒。

For target-blind TF-IDF/K-Means,
V-measure~\cite{rosenberg-hirschberg-2007-v-measure} over operation assignments
reaches 0.557 on nine Mind2Web sessions (49 operations) and 0.815 on 100
ScienceWorld sessions (2{,}504 operations)~\cite{mind2web,scienceworld}.
Every operation receives a prediction in both datasets, whereas a constant tag
yields V-measure 0. Here, V-measure tests partitions, not literal names.
% 对目标盲 TF-IDF/K-Means backend，在 9 个 Mind2Web session（49 个 operation）和 100 个 ScienceWorld session（2,504 个 operation）上，operation assignment 的标准 V-measure 为 0.557 和 0.815，coverage 为 100%，constant tag 为 0；V-measure 测试 partition 而非字面 tag 名。

For task-family tags, \sys's declared-task field interface uses a fixed
Qwen3.6-27B llama.cpp backend to classify all 1{,}012 AgentBoard goals into
nine families using only goals and declared family
descriptions~\cite{qwen36,agentboard}. It reaches 0.695 macro-F1 and 0.733
accuracy versus a majority-class baseline at 0.044 and 0.248, with identical
assignments across three runs.
% 对于 task-family 标签，AgentProf 的 declared-task 字段接口使用固定 Qwen3.6-27B llama.cpp backend，仅根据 goal 与已声明 family 描述将 AgentBoard 发布的全部 1,012 个 goal 指派到九个 family；macro-F1 与 accuracy 分别为 0.695 和 0.733，majority control 为 0.044 和 0.248，三次完整运行的指派完全一致。

For action tags, a standalone backend-level adapter applies the fixed
Qwen3.6-27B closed-label configuration to only the current thought/action and
eight definitions for all 2{,}737 published annotations from 120
AutoCodeRover, OpenHands, and RepairAgent
trajectories~\cite{qwen36,bouzenia-pradel-2025-trajectories,traceview-2026}.
% 在独立的 action-label backend 评估中，standalone adapter 使用固定 Qwen3.6-27B closed-label 配置，仅读取当前 thought/action 与八个已声明定义，在 AutoCodeRover、OpenHands 和 RepairAgent 的 120 条轨迹上测试全部 2,737 个公开标注；它不是已集成的 AgentProf CLI 路径。
The model reaches 0.498 macro-F1 and 0.628 accuracy versus a majority-class baseline at 0.061
and 0.323. Its 0.437 macro-F1 gain has a whole-trajectory 95\% bootstrap
interval of [0.380, 0.494], and both complete runs agree exactly.
% 其 macro-F1 与 accuracy 分别为 0.498 和 0.628，majority 为 0.061 和 0.323；macro-F1 增量为 0.437，整条轨迹 bootstrap 的 95% 区间为 [0.380, 0.494]，两次完整运行结果完全一致。
Thirty-nine AutoCodeRover inputs literally contain the target word
\texttt{Locate}. Excluding them leaves 0.490 macro-F1 and 0.622 accuracy, so the
positive comparison to majority is unchanged.
% 39 个 AutoCodeRover 可见输入字面包含目标词 \texttt{Locate}；排除它们后 macro-F1 与 accuracy 仍为 0.490 和 0.622，因此相对 majority 的正向比较不变。

Thus, on the named public populations, RQ3 establishes target-blind task
partitions at V-measure 0.557 and 0.815, phase structure at 0.654 ordinary
B$^3$ F1, task-family assignment at 0.695 macro-F1, action assignment at 0.498
macro-F1, and label-free group boundaries at 0.680 boundary F1 and 0.786
B$^3$ F1.
% 因此，在指定公开 population 上，RQ3 确立了 V-measure 为 0.557/0.815 的 target-blind task partition、普通 B$^3$ F1 为 0.654 的 phase structure、macro-F1 为 0.695 的 task-family assignment、macro-F1 为 0.498 的 action assignment，以及 boundary/B$^3$ F1 为 0.680/0.786 的 label-free group boundary。

%% -------------------------------------------------------------------
\subsection{RQ4: Profiling Cost}
% RQ4：分析开销是多少？

RQ4 measures the time to parse fixed-field operation JSONL, construct stacks,
fold weights, and serialize the profile. The measurement excludes capture,
source adaptation, and field/tag generation. Across four complete public
workloads and their union, we compare the fixed semantic hierarchy
\texttt{project, agent, task, phase, op, tool, status} with the raw hierarchy
\texttt{project, agent, action, status} on identical inputs over three runs.
Measurements use \texttt{agentpprof 0.2.37} on a 24-core Intel Core Ultra 9
285K with 125\,GiB RAM and Linux 6.15.11.
% RQ4 测量 operation-input profile construction：解析带固定字段的 operation JSONL、构造 stack、折叠权重并序列化 profile；不含 capture、source adaptation 和 field/tag generation。我们在四个完整公开 workload 及其 union 上各运行三次，并比较固定 semantic hierarchy 与相同输入的 raw action。

\begin{table}[tb]
\centering\small
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{3pt}
\begin{tabular}{@{}lrrrr@{}}
\toprule
Workload & Ops & \shortstack{Semantic\\(s)} & \shortstack{Raw action\\(s)} & \shortstack{Peak RSS\\(MiB)} \\
\midrule
AgentRewardBench & 729 & 0.04 & 0.03 & 19.0 \\
SATraj-OS & 4{,}285 & 0.17 & 0.14 & 73.5 \\
OSWorld-Human & 6{,}010 & 0.25 & 0.21 & 108.4 \\
AgentNet & 16{,}741 & 0.71 & 0.58 & 278.4 \\
Union & 27{,}765 & 1.17 & 0.99 & 464.5 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\caption{RQ4 profile-construction cost. Times are three-run medians, and
resident set size (RSS) is the largest peak observed for the semantic profile.}
\label{tab:rq4-cost}
\end{table}

Both time curves are monotonic across the five input sizes. The semantic curve
has a descriptive slope of 0.0422\,ms per operation ($R^2=0.9997$), reaching
23{,}731 operations/s on the union.
% 两条时间曲线在五个自然输入规模上均单调增长。语义曲线的描述性斜率为每个 operation 0.0422 毫秒（R 方为 0.9997），在并集上达到每秒 23,731 个 operation。
RQ4 therefore finds that, for 27{,}765 operations, semantic construction
completes in 1.17 seconds using 464.5\,MiB, takes 180\,ms (18.2\%) more time,
and uses 6.0\,MiB (1.3\%) more peak RSS than raw-action grouping.
% 因此，RQ4 表明当前 binary 在测试范围内具有实用的构建开销：最大的 27,765-operation profile 在 1.17 秒内完成，使用 464.5 MiB，相对 raw action 增加 18.2% 时间和 1.3% 内存。

\paragraph{Evidence synthesis.}
The four RQs validate different links in one profiling chain. RQ1 tests scoped
effect lineage and conservation before measuring partition agreement, while
RQ2 tests independently annotated problem ranking and semantic refinement of
operation-local evidence. RQ3 tests the pluggable field interface through
literal task/action labels and structural partitions and boundaries, and RQ4
tests fixed-input profile construction. Together,
they connect cross-layer operations and selectable operation stacks to the
attribution, localization, semantic-field, and cost questions that motivate
agent profiling.

\subsection{Scope and Limitations}

RQ1 covers 20 fixed tasks under declared process/tool scope and all 405 failed
CodeTraceBench trajectories~\cite{li2026codetracer} reconstructable as official
operation sequences. Because this corpus influenced constructor selection, its
result is post-hoc support, not independent confirmation.

RQ2 evaluates all target-bearing queries in the three named released
populations. Its local-first mechanism analysis is adaptive to those same
populations and does not replace the primary semantic-versus-raw comparison.

RQ3 tests CodeTraceBench phase structure, Mind2Web/ScienceWorld partitions, a
named backend over nine task families and eight action tags, and
session-held-out OSWorld-Human boundaries. These measurements cover the named
populations and declared tag sets.

RQ4 covers parsing fixed-field operation input, stack construction, folding,
and serialization. Capture, source adaptation, field/tag generation, and live
agent overhead remain outside that construction-cost measurement.
% 离线 profile-construction evaluation 不含 capture、live-agent overhead、source adaptation 和 field/tag generation。RQ1 覆盖声明进程/工具范围内的 20 个固定任务，以及 released source 能生成官方 operation sequence 的全部 405 条失败 CodeTraceBench 轨迹；CodeTraceBench 影响了当前 constructor 的选择，因此它是 post-hoc support 而非 independent confirmation。RQ3 测试 CodeTraceBench 的 phase structure、Mind2Web/ScienceWorld 的 task partition、一个指定 backend 在九个声明的 task family 与八个 action tag 上的 accuracy，以及 OSWorld-Human 的 session-held-out group boundary；这些测量覆盖指定 population 和声明的 tag set。


%% ===================================================================
\section{Related Work}
% 相关工作

\textbf{Agent observability.}
Platforms aggregate spans, metadata, and evaluations~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,
otel,datadog-llmobs}. Datadog Patterns and LangSmith Insights derive
cross-trace hierarchies and roll up metrics, NeMo profiles instrumented
workflows, and OpenTelemetry Profiles links profiles to traces~\cite{datadog-patterns,
langsmith-insights,nemo-agent-toolkit-profiler,otel-profiles}. These establish
grouping, rollups, profile naming and compatibility, and trace linkage. \sys's
residual capability is their conjunction in one operation corpus: joining agent
actions to process, file, and network effects while conserving arbitrary
additive measures and supporting selectable query-time field stacks.
% Agent observability 平台收集 span、metadata 与 evaluation signal，并提供单次运行或群体 dashboard；部分系统派生跨 trace 类别，NeMo Agent Toolkit profiler 聚合 instrumented workflow 的 token、latency、bottleneck 与 concurrency。范围化的 AgentSight-to-\sys 路径将系统副作用连接到负责的 agent action；\sys 将其跨异构历史的可加度量折叠为可选 pprof profile。

\textbf{Cross-run agent analysis.}
TraceProbe supplies resource-aware process profiles, while Graphectory builds
per-trajectory process graphs with aggregated phase patterns~\cite{traceprobe2026,
graphectory2026}.
Hodoscope compares
behavior distributions to direct human review, while TraceGraph builds shared
decision landscapes that guide recovery~\cite{hodoscope2026,tracegraph2026}.
Together, these systems establish canonical actions, recurring cross-run
structure, and analysis-to-decision precedents. \sys complements them with
source-linked heterogeneous effects, conservation of user-selected additive
measures, and multiple operation-stack projections over the same histories.

\textbf{Profiling and diagnosis.}
pprof and flame graphs fold runtime stacks, whereas Perfetto queries trace
events~\cite{pprof,flamegraphs,perfetto}. AgentRx diagnoses failures,
CodeTracer reconstructs per-run states, and localization benchmarks score
faulty steps, agents, or expert-supported perspectives~\cite{agentrx,
li2026codetracer,agentprocessbench,hintbench,traceelephant,mpbench2026}.
\sys applies the profiler's population-level principle
to agents by treating completed trajectories as samples and using query-time
operation stacks to fold recurring semantic responsibility without code
identity or runtime nesting.
% AgentRx 诊断执行失败，CodeTracer 重建层次化状态转移以支持定位与 replay；AgentProcessBench、HINTBench 和 TraceElephant 衡量方法是否识别故障 step 或 agent。\sys 回答互补的群体问题：哪些重复语义责任在跨轨迹中累积资源使用或问题，并将其表示为聚合 profile 而非另一种单次运行诊断。

%% ===================================================================
\section{Conclusion}
% 结论

Agent observability needs profiling, not only debugging. \sys represents
heterogeneous agent actions and system effects as weighted operations and folds
selectable query-time operation stacks across runs. On complete real and public
workloads, its profiles preserve linked
effects, improve human-stage partition agreement and problem-localization MAP
over raw action, and recover OSWorld-Human groups at 0.680 boundary F1 and
0.786 B$^3$ F1. A 27{,}765-operation profile builds in 1.17 seconds, making
population-level profiling a practical complement to per-run debugging.
% 在真实与公开轨迹上，这些 profile 相比 raw action identity 改善归因、优先呈现独立标注的问题、恢复有用的 task、action 与 group 结构，并在 1.17 秒内构建最大的已评估 profile。

\bibliography{references}

\end{document}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Render paper-readable flamegraph panels from existing exact SVG profiles.

This is a presentation-only transform: x positions and rectangle widths are
copied unchanged, while the redundant title/metadata band is removed and rows
are made tall enough for 9-point labels at the paper's final width.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path


SVG = "{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}"
ROW_HEIGHT = 24.0
ROW_GAP = 1.0
FONT_SIZE = 24.0
TEXT_BASELINE = 19.0
CHAR_WIDTH = 14.4


def render(source: Path, output: Path) -> None:
    tree = ET.parse(source)
    root = tree.getroot()
    width = float(root.attrib["width"])

    groups = [child for child in root if child.tag == f"{SVG}g"]
    source_rows = sorted(
        {
            float(rect.attrib["y"])
            for group in groups
            if (rect := group.find(f"{SVG}rect")) is not None
        }
    )
    row_index = {value: index for index, value in enumerate(source_rows)}
    height = len(source_rows) * (ROW_HEIGHT + ROW_GAP) - ROW_GAP

    for child in list(root):
        if child.tag != f"{SVG}g":
            root.remove(child)

    root.attrib.update(
        {
            "width": str(int(width)),
            "height": str(int(height)),
            "viewBox": f"0 0 {int(width)} {int(height)}",
        }
    )
    root.insert(
        0,
        ET.Element(
            f"{SVG}style",
            {},
        ),
    )
    root[0].text = (
        f"text{{font-family:DejaVu Sans Mono,monospace;font-size:{FONT_SIZE:g}px;"
        "pointer-events:none}"
    )
    background = ET.Element(
        f"{SVG}rect",
        {"width": str(int(width)), "height": str(int(height)), "fill": "#fbfbf7"},
    )
    root.insert(1, background)

    for group in groups:
        rect = group.find(f"{SVG}rect")
        if rect is None:
            continue
        old_y = float(rect.attrib["y"])
        new_y = row_index[old_y] * (ROW_HEIGHT + ROW_GAP)
        rect.attrib["y"] = f"{new_y:.3f}"
        rect.attrib["height"] = str(int(ROW_HEIGHT))

        text = group.find(f"{SVG}text")
        if text is None or not text.text:
            continue
        text.attrib["y"] = f"{new_y + TEXT_BASELINE:.3f}"
        available = max(0, int((float(rect.attrib["width"]) - 8.0) / CHAR_WIDTH))
        if available < 2:
            group.remove(text)
        elif len(text.text) > available:
            text.text = text.text[: max(1, available - 1)] + "."

    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ET.register_namespace("", "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg")
    tree.write(output, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("source", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    render(args.source, args.output)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

input.content:
# 01 — Blind Full Read and Reject-Hypothesis Map

- **Reviewer:** Independent Claude Opus milestone reviewer (AgentProf, AAAI-27 main track)
- **Report written:** 2026-07-19 (local session date), step `step-0048-20260719T185709-0700`, `milestone-review-001`
- **Stage:** Step 1 of 4 — unprimed blind read. **No** prior review, `docs/tmp/`, `docs/evaluation.md`, `docs/idea-story.md`, `docs/user-instruction.md`, `docs/background-related-work.md`, or proposed fix has been read at the time of writing.
- **Procedural note:** The requested `/iter-review-critique` command does not exist in this environment. I checked `~/.claude/commands/` (4 unrelated commands), the repo `skills/` tree, and a home-directory-wide glob for `*iter-review*` / `*critique*`. No skill definition was found. I therefore executed the four-step protocol exactly as specified in the invoking instruction, which is itself fully specified.

## Inputs and provenance

| Artifact | Path | What I used it for |
|---|---|---|
| Paper source | `docs/paper/main.tex` (1,004 lines, read in full, both pages) | All claims, all RQ text |
| Compiled paper | `docs/paper/main.pdf` (9 pages, read all 9 as images) | Layout, page budget, rendered tables, reference list |
| Bibliography | `docs/paper/references.bib` (1,254 lines, read in full) | Citation inventory, VERIFIED annotations, used/unused status |
| Build log | `docs/paper/main.log` | Page count, undefined citations/references, overfull boxes |
| Figure 1 source | `docs/paper/figures/fig-architecture.tex` | Pipeline claim vs. text |
| Figure 2 panels | `flamegraph-{tokens,time,files}-paper.png` + `.svg` | Read as images at full resolution; grepped SVG frame labels |
| Figure render script | `docs/paper/figures/render-paper-flamegraphs.py` | Confirmed panels are presentation-only transforms of exact profiles (x-positions/widths copied unchanged) |

Verification method: I recomputed every derivable number in Tables 1–4 from the reported components, cross-checked abstract/intro/body/conclusion for each headline figure, and inspected the claim-bearing figure at native resolution rather than trusting the caption.

---

## 1. One-paragraph summary of the paper as I read it

AgentProf argues that AI-agent observability has tracing and debugging but no *profiling* layer, and proposes a "semantic operation stack model": every agent activity (prompt, LLM call, tool call, file/process/network effect) becomes a uniform weighted `operation` record with string fields and additive measures; a *query-time* ordered field list replaces the runtime call stack, and operations with identical projected field sequences are folded with summed weights, yielding pprof-compatible flame graphs. The system is an ~9.8K-line offline Rust CLI with pluggable "intent attribution" backends (regex rules, local LLM tagger, TF-IDF/K-Means) and a "label-free recurrence" stack constructor that segments action sequences using NPMI over adjacent visible-action transitions with a 1-D k-means (k=2) cutoff. Evaluation spans four RQs: scoped capture/join fidelity plus B³ partition agreement on 405 CodeTraceBench trajectories (RQ1); MAP on three problem-localization benchmarks (RQ2); tag/partition/boundary accuracy on OSWorld-Human, AgentBoard, ASE trajectories, Mind2Web, ScienceWorld (RQ3); and profile-construction time/memory (RQ4).

---

## 2. Positive findings (stated first, and I want them on record)

These are real strengths and I do not want the critique below to obscure them.

**P1 — Arithmetic integrity is unusually high.** I independently recomputed every F1 in Tables 1 and 3 from the reported precision/recall and every derived statistic in RQ4. All 12 F1 values reproduce to the printed precision. Non-trivial checks that passed:
- `Always boundary` precision 0.476 must equal (true boundaries)/(adjacent pairs) = (2042 groups − 287 sessions)/3691 = 1755/3691 = 0.4755. ✓
- Adjacent pairs must equal operations − sessions: 3978 − 287 = 3691. ✓
- RQ1 recall 1520/1574 = 0.96569. ✓ (abstract's 96.6% is a correct rounding)
- RQ4 union ops 729+4285+6010+16741 = 27,765. ✓
- RQ4 slope: 27,765 × 0.0422 ms = 1.172 s ≈ 1.17 s; 27,765/1.17 = 23,731 ops/s. ✓
- RQ4 deltas: 1.17−0.99 = 0.18 s; 0.18/0.99 = 18.2%. ✓

This internal consistency is better than most submissions I read and it materially raises my prior that the experiments were actually run as described.

**P2 — Unusually candid limitation disclosure.** The paper states in-body that (a) CodeTraceBench "influenced constructor selection… post-hoc support rather than independent confirmation"; (b) the OSWorld recurrence rule was "designed after inspecting earlier results on this corpus… development evidence rather than independent cross-family confirmation"; (c) the RQ2 local-first analysis "is adaptive to those same populations… not untouched confirmation"; (d) phase-only (0.654) essentially matches the flagship recurrence method (0.649) and the experiment therefore "supports semantic responsibility partitioning… but not recurrence alone or one universally dominant semantic profile"; (e) the action-label result comes from "a standalone backend-level adapter," not the integrated CLI. This is genuinely commendable epistemic hygiene.

**P3 — Metric choices are standard and correctly cited to primary sources.** B³ → Bagga & Baldwin 1998; V-measure → Rosenberg & Hirschberg 2007; macro-F1/accuracy → Lewis et al. 2004; AP/MAP → Robertson 2008; exact boundary P/R/F1 → Ruokolainen et al. 2016; Wilson LB → Wilson 1927; NPMI → Bouma 2009. Every one is the correct primary source, not a secondary. Ties are handled explicitly ("evaluating ties at their shared score threshold"), which is the correct and often-omitted choice for a method that produces many tied scores.

**P4 — Controls are matched, not strawmen, within their frame.** RQ1's raw-action / phase-only / action-kind / per-session / per-operation ladder and RQ3's always-boundary / action-change / phase-change ladder are the right degenerate controls, and the paper reports the ones that beat it (phase-only in RQ1; supervised predictor in RQ3).

**P5 — Compliant format.** `main.log` reports 9 pages, body ends with Conclusion on page 7, references occupy pages 8–9 — consistent with AAAI's 7-body + 2-reference allowance. No undefined citations or references in the log; only underfull hboxes.

---

## 3. Blocking findings

### B1 — The headline cost claim omits the dominant cost term, and the abstract does not disclose this

RQ4 answers "What is the profiling cost?" with "27,765 operations in 1.17 s." But RQ4's own protocol says: *"The measurement excludes capture, source adaptation, and field/tag generation."* Field/tag generation is the mechanism the entire paper rests on (D2, intent attribution, contribution 2). In RQ3 that generation is a **Qwen3.6-27B** model invoked per item. Profiling 27,765 operations with a 27B model is not a 1.17-second operation; it is plausibly 3–5 orders of magnitude more expensive, and it is the term a practitioner actually cares about.

Excluding it is defensible as a *component* measurement. Putting "AgentProf constructs a 27,765-operation profile in 1.17 s" in the **abstract** and the **conclusion** with no exclusion qualifier is not. The abstract sentence reads as an end-to-end system cost and will be read that way by every reviewer and every reader. The Scope and Limitations paragraph discloses the exclusion; the abstract, intro ¶7, and conclusion do not.

This also interacts with the motivation. The intro's stated problem is that "LLM judging requires a separate evaluator pass per trajectory" (expensive). If AgentProf's own tagging path requires a 27B LLM pass per *operation* — a finer granularity than per trajectory — the paper has not established that it is cheaper than the thing it criticizes. **No experiment in the paper compares AgentProf's end-to-end cost to the per-trajectory LLM-judge cost it uses as motivation.** That is a missing requirement, not an optional strengthening: it is the load-bearing economic premise of the introduction.

### B2 — The flagship algorithm has zero untouched evaluation population

The label-free recurrence constructor is evaluated on exactly two populations, and the paper itself declares both contaminated by method selection:
- CodeTraceBench (RQ1): "this corpus influenced constructor selection… post-hoc support, not independent confirmation."
- OSWorld-Human (RQ3): "we designed the recurrence rule after inspecting earlier results on this corpus… development evidence rather than independent cross-family confirmation."

So the paper's central algorithmic contribution has **no** held-out generalization evidence anywhere. The honesty is admirable; the evidentiary state is not repairable by wording. For an AAAI main-track paper whose contribution 2 is a mechanism, an unbiased estimate of that mechanism's performance on an untouched population is a **requirement**, not a strengthening. Any one of the 15 already-adapted families (τ-bench, ScaleCUA, AgentTrek, GUI Odyssey, WebLINX, AndroidControl…) could serve, and the adapters already exist, so the cost of fixing this is low relative to its severity.

Compounding this: on CodeTraceBench the trivial deterministic `phase` field (0.654 B³ F1) **beats** the induced recurrence constructor (0.649). So on the one population where a simple alternative was measured, the sophisticated method lost. The paper reports this in-body — but the abstract, intro ¶7, and conclusion report only "0.541 → 0.649 over raw action" and never mention that a one-line deterministic rule scored higher. A reader of the abstract acquires a false impression of the method's standing. This is a selective-reporting problem at the abstract level even though the body is honest.

### B3 — RQ2's construct does not measure what RQ2 asks

RQ2 asks: "Does profiler output correspond to real problems?" The experiment measures something narrower. From the protocol: *"AgentProf and raw-action grouping use identical operations and the same benchmark-provided judge votes or localizer hits. The two methods differ only in grouping."*

So the problem signal is **supplied by the benchmark**. AgentProf does not detect problems; it re-aggregates a per-step problem score that already exists, and MAP measures how well one grouping smooths that supplied signal versus another grouping. The correct claim is "semantic grouping smooths an externally supplied diagnostic signal better than raw-action grouping." The claim as written ("profiler output corresponds to real problems") implies discovery.

Three consequences:
1. The post-hoc `Local` column makes this explicit and is damaging: on AgentProcessBench, using the supplied per-operation score *alone* (0.863) beats the full semantic profile (0.789) by a wide margin. The paper's own best configuration, `Local+S`, is "use the existing per-step score, and break exact ties with the profile" — which is the definition of a marginal refinement, and the paper says so. But the thesis under evaluation is "observability needs profiling, **not only** debugging." A per-operation local diagnostic score *is* the debugging-style signal. Demonstrating that profiling functions as a tie-breaker on top of it is weak support for the thesis and arguably evidence against its strong form.
2. `+.016 [.005,.027]` on AgentProcessBench is statistically positive and practically negligible. Reporting "improves MAP on all three" in the abstract without indicating that one of the three gains is ~2% relative overstates uniformity.
3. **Under-specification with leakage implications.** "Benchmark-provided … localizer hits" for HINTBench/TraceElephant is not defined. If "hits" are the outputs of an independent localizer model, the setup is sound but the contribution is re-ranking. If "hits" are derived from the target annotations, the Wilson-LB scoring is circular. The paper never says which. A reviewer cannot resolve this from the text, and it determines whether RQ2 is valid at all. This must be specified.

### B4 — RQ1's strongest-sounding number is at risk of being definitionally true

"100.0% precision … rejects all 1,629 control effects" is the most quotable number in the abstract. But the scope is defined as *"the captured target agent process and its launched tool command, excluding concurrent control activity."* If the negative control is a **separate concurrent process tree**, then rejecting its effects is what correct application of a PID-tree scope rule *must* do. The experiment then verifies that the implementation correctly applies its own definition — a valuable engineering regression test, but not a discriminating scientific result, and 1,629/1,629 with zero errors is the signature of a definitional rather than empirical outcome.

What would make this discriminating: controls that are *hard* — same-process-tree confusable effects, shared file descriptors, a second agent in the same tree, a tool that daemonizes or double-forks, effects arriving after the tool command exits, PID reuse. None are present. As written, the number invites a reviewer to conclude the authors measured the easy case and reported it as the headline.

Related: the abstract credits this result to **AgentSight** ("AgentSight capture and joining reach 100.0% precision and 96.6% recall"), which is cited prior work, in AgentProf's abstract. AgentProf's contribution in this experiment is the adapter plus lossless folding. Lossless folding of additive measures is arithmetic — summation preserves sums — and presenting "preserved the input and all five predeclared task-category totals" as a finding is closer to a unit test than a result.

### B5 — The model contribution is not positioned against the two fields that already own it

The formalization is: a view `(φ, σ, w)` where `φ` selects records, `σ` projects onto an ordered list of dimension fields, `w` supplies a non-negative additive measure, and records with equal projections are merged with summed weights.

That is a **`SELECT σ-fields, SUM(w) … WHERE φ … GROUP BY` roll-up over an ordered dimension list on a fact table** — i.e., the OLAP data-cube roll-up, ~1997 vintage. The "operations" are a star-schema fact table with dimension attributes and additive measures; "query-time selectable stacks" is dimension-order choice; "folding" is aggregation. The paper cites **zero** OLAP/data-cube work.

Separately, "induce a hierarchy/abstraction over a semantically labeled event log with case IDs, activity labels, timestamps, and attributes" is the founding problem of **process mining**, where segmenting low-level events into higher-level activities is a named, heavily studied subproblem ("event abstraction"). The paper cites **zero** process-mining work.

Third, "aggregate heterogeneous cross-layer trace events at query time into customizable views" is the stated core contribution of production distributed-tracing aggregation systems, and "join effects across layers via a happened-before relation with dynamic query-time aggregation" is the stated core contribution of at least one well-known SOSP paper. None are cited. (I will verify the specific systems in Report 02 rather than assert from memory here.)

I am *not* claiming the paper is unoriginal. Applying this to agent trajectories, joining kernel-level effects to natural-language intent, and emitting pprof are real contributions. I am claiming that a paper whose **first** contribution is a data model must position that model against the fields that already formalize it, and this one does not even acknowledge them. A systems reviewer will see the OLAP equivalence on the first read of the `(φ, σ, w)` paragraph. This is the highest-probability reject trigger in the paper.

### B6 — No comparison to any named prior system

Related Work names Datadog Patterns, LangSmith Insights, NeMo Agent Toolkit Profiler, OpenTelemetry Profiles, TraceProbe, Graphectory, WebGraphEval, Hodoscope, TraceGraph, AgentRx, CodeTracer. **Not one appears as an experimental baseline.** Every baseline in every table is either a degenerate internal control (raw-action, per-session, per-operation, always-boundary, action-change, phase-change) or a majority-class floor.

The novelty claim is explicitly a **conjunction** claim: "AgentProf's residual capability is their conjunction in one operation corpus." A conjunction claim is the weakest possible novelty form, and it makes the missing comparison worse, not better: if the argument is "each prior system has 2 of 3 properties and we have 3 of 3," the paper must show that the third property *buys* something measurable relative to a system with 2. It never does.

Concretely, TraceProbe (canonical action types + cross-run token/duration rollups) and Graphectory (per-trajectory process graphs with aggregated phase patterns) look like they could be run on CodeTraceBench or OSWorld-Human as grouping baselines in RQ1/RQ3. Their absence, given they are cited as the closest work, will be read as avoidance.

---

## 4. Major findings

### M1 — Internal inconsistency: the implemented tagger (3B) is not the evaluated tagger (27B)
Implementation §"Field derivation": *"A local LLM tagger runs a quantized 3B-parameter model through llama.cpp."* RQ3: *"a fixed Qwen3.6-27B llama.cpp backend"* (twice). The paper never reconciles these. Either the Implementation section describes a configuration that was not evaluated, or RQ3 evaluates a configuration the system does not ship. Both readings damage the "System" contribution, and this directly compounds B1 (a 27B model makes the excluded tagging cost far larger than a 3B model would).

### M2 — Figure 2, the flagship qualitative artifact, argues against the paper's own thesis in three ways
I inspected all three panels at native resolution and grepped the source SVGs.

1. **`session` is a stack level in all three panels** (`session:review`, `session:dev`, and truncated `sessi.`/`se.`/`ses.`/`s.`). The Design section says: *"Sessions and spans are optional fields, not hierarchy levels. The same data supports debugging views with `session` and aggregate profiling views without that field."* By the paper's own definition, **Figure 2 is a debugging view.** The paper's single showcase figure for "profiling, not only debugging" is session-stratified, which prevents folding of identical semantics across sessions at every level above `session`. The paper should show the aggregate view its thesis calls for.
2. **The dominant semantic tag is vacuous.** In the tokens panel, the single widest prompt frame is `prompt:continue` — I confirmed via SVG grep that this exact string is the dominant label. "Continue" is not an intent category; it is the absence of one. D2 requires "short, repeatable tags" that carry semantic responsibility. The showcase figure's largest bucket carries none.
3. **The `files` panel does not fold.** Its top three rows contain no legible label at any width — every frame is a sub-2-character sliver, meaning hundreds of singleton or near-singleton stacks. The render script drops labels when `width < ~2 chars`, so this is an accurate depiction: at the `files` weight, folding achieves almost no compression above the prompt level. A flame graph that is visually indistinguishable from noise is evidence that the operation-stack abstraction is not producing reusable cross-run structure for that resource.

Also, the three panels use **different field orders** (tokens: prompt→call→model→kind; time: prompt→kind→call→model), which is permitted by the caption ("differ only in included operations, stack fields, and the additive width measure") but weakens the rhetorical point that the *same* stack under *different weights* reveals different bottlenecks. And the `time`/`tokens` divergence claim (7/10 overlap, Spearman ρ = 0.623, network 8th vs 93rd) is a single-corpus observation with no significance test and an unsurprising conclusion (wall-clock ≠ token count).

### M3 — No sensitivity analysis of profile conclusions to tag error
RQ3 measures tag accuracy in isolation: 0.498 macro-F1 for action tags over 8 classes, 0.695 for task families over 9. Roughly half the action tags are wrong. Nowhere does the paper measure **what a 50%-accurate tag does to the resulting profile's conclusions** — do the top-k semantic frames by token weight survive? Does the RQ1 B³ or RQ2 MAP degrade gracefully or collapse? A profiler whose attribution layer is 50% accurate needs an error-propagation experiment before its output can be trusted for the population-level decisions the introduction promises ("where failures concentrate," "which task categories consume the most budget"). This is the highest-value **missing requirement** after B2, and it is directly runnable with existing artifacts (inject label noise at measured rates; re-rank; report rank stability).

### M4 — The unsupervised-segmentation baseline set is empty
The label-free recurrence constructor is: score adjacent symbol transitions by NPMI, threshold, cut where the score is low. This is a textbook unsupervised segmentation recipe. The paper cites Ruokolainen et al. 2016 — *a comparative study of minimally supervised morphological segmentation* — **for the metric only**, while ignoring that literature's methods as baselines. Standard comparators the paper owes: branching-entropy / successor-variety boundary detection (the classic transition-uncertainty method, essentially free to implement and arguably the closest cousin of NPMI thresholding), TextTiling-style lexical-cohesion segmentation, a Bayesian/HMM change-point segmenter, and a frequency-only threshold ablation (does NPMI beat raw transition count?). Without at least the NPMI-vs-frequency ablation, the paper has not shown that *NPMI specifically* contributes anything over "cut at rare transitions."

Likewise, the 1-D k-means (k=2) cutoff is one of many thresholding rules (Otsu, elbow, percentile). No ablation. The paper describes tie-breaking, initialization, and the two-cutoff refinement in careful detail — which is good for reproducibility — but detailed description of an unablated heuristic reads as complexity without earned justification.

### M5 — Missing selection denominators
- CodeTraceBench: "all 405 failed trajectories **whose released sources yield the official operation sequence**." Out of how many? The filter is disclosed; the denominator is not. If 405/2000, selection bias is a live threat; if 405/430, it is not. Unreportable as written.
- The population is also **failures only**. The introduction motivates cost and budget questions across the whole population; evaluating partition agreement only on failed runs is a scoped choice that is never justified.
- HINTBench correctly discloses 536/629. This makes the CodeTraceBench omission look like an oversight rather than a policy, which is fixable.

### M6 — Anonymity risk under AAAI double-blind review
Figure 2's root frame in all three panels is literally `project:agentsight`. The text names the tool binary `agentpprof 0.2.37`, and AgentSight is cited as third-party prior work by the group whose public tool shares that name. A reviewer who searches `agentpprof` will find the authors. Third-person citation of one's own prior work is standard and fine; a **figure whose root frame is the authors' project name**, plus an exact public binary version string, is a different matter. Whether this rises to a desk-reject depends on the AC, but it is a real, cheaply fixable submission risk.

### M7 — Three recent, directly relevant, already-verified references are in the .bib but uncited
`agentlens2026` (process-level/context-sensitive intent-stage evaluation over OpenHands trajectories), `procbench2026` (process-level defect evaluation over coding-agent trajectories), and `agentlocate2026` (responsible-agent + decisive-step failure localization) all carry `VERIFIED: 2026-07-19` and none carries `STATUS: unused`, unlike the ~12 entries that are explicitly marked unused. Every one is adjacent to RQ2/RQ3 framing. Their presence-but-absence suggests they were verified for citation and then not wired in. Positioning against process-level trajectory evaluation is exactly where RQ3's "semantic stage" claim is most contestable.

---

## 5. Minor findings

- **m1.** Table 4 reports one `Peak RSS` column (semantic only), but the prose claims "6.0 MiB (1.3%) more peak RSS than raw-action grouping." The raw-action RSS is not in the table; the delta is unverifiable from the artifact. Add the column.
- **m2.** RQ4's slope (0.0422 ms/op, R² = 0.9997) is fit over **five** points spanning one order of magnitude, four of which are components of the fifth (Union = sum of the other four). The four workloads and their union are not independent observations; R² = 0.9997 is close to guaranteed by construction. Call it descriptive (the paper does say "descriptive slope") but drop the R².
- **m3.** "approximately 9.8K-line offline Rust CLI" — LOC is not a contribution measure and invites the reviewer to ask what the other 9.5K lines do.
- **m4.** AgentSight and agentpprof both at version `0.2.37`. Plausible in a monorepo; worth a clarifying half-sentence since it reads like a typo.
- **m5.** RQ3's OSWorld-Human subset (3,978 ops) vs. RQ4's OSWorld-Human (6,010 ops) is disclosed only implicitly via "with complete group annotations." State the 3,978/6,010 fraction.
- **m6.** No error bars in Tables 3 and 4; no significance tests for any RQ3 comparison. RQ1 and RQ2 report CIs; RQ3 reports a CI only for the standalone action adapter. Inconsistent statistical rigor across RQs.
- **m7.** The supervised Bernoulli-NB predictor beats the paper's own label-free method (0.739 vs 0.680 boundary F1; 0.816 vs 0.786 B³). The paper notes label-free "does not use annotations" but never argues why a developer with 287 annotated sessions should prefer the weaker method, nor whether the two compose.
- **m8.** No reproducibility/artifact-availability statement in `main.pdf`. `ReproducibilityChecklist.tex` exists separately and is not part of the compiled submission.
- **m9.** Every Chinese-comment line is retained in `main.tex`. Harmless to the PDF but a leak risk if the `.tex` is ever shared as supplementary material.
- **m10.** 13 underfull hboxes in the log, several at badness 10000. Cosmetic.

---

## 6. Reject-hypothesis map

For each hypothesis: what a hostile reviewer would claim, what in the paper supports it, what refutes it, and what evidence would settle it.

| # | Reject hypothesis | Supporting evidence in paper | Refuting evidence in paper | Discriminating evidence needed | My current credence that a reviewer raises it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **RH1** | *"The model is OLAP roll-up on an event table, renamed."* | `(φ, σ, w)` = select/project/aggregate; ordered field list = dimension order; folding = SUM GROUP BY; zero OLAP or process-mining citations | Cross-layer eBPF→intent join and pprof export are not OLAP contributions; agent-specific tag induction is genuinely new | Explicit positioning section: what an OLAP cube over the same fact table cannot express, ideally with a concrete query the cube cannot answer | **High (~80%)** |
| **RH2** | *"The headline cost number excludes the cost that matters."* | RQ4 excludes field/tag generation; RQ3 uses a 27B model; abstract states 1.17 s unqualified | Scope and Limitations discloses the exclusion; folding cost genuinely is the system's cost | End-to-end wall-clock and $ for a full profile including tagging, compared against per-trajectory LLM judging | **High (~75%)** |
| **RH3** | *"No baseline is a real system; all are degenerate controls."* | Zero named prior systems evaluated; conjunction-form novelty claim | Degenerate controls are the right *floor*, and are matched on inputs | ≥1 named prior grouping method (TraceProbe / Graphectory / LangSmith-Insights-style clustering) run on RQ1 or RQ3 inputs | **High (~75%)** |
| **RH4** | *"The core algorithm was tuned on both of its evaluation sets."* | Paper states this for CodeTraceBench and OSWorld-Human explicitly | Honest disclosure; the RQ3 protocol is properly session-held-out *within* the corpus | One untouched family (adapters already exist), pre-registered fields, single run | **High (~70%)** |
| **RH5** | *"RQ2 shows profiling is a tie-breaker, i.e., evidence against the thesis."* | `Local` alone beats `Semantic` on AgentProcessBench (.863 vs .789); best config is local-first with semantic tie-break; +.016 on one workload | Semantic beats local on HINTBench (.452 vs .411) and TraceElephant (.230 vs .209); semantic beats raw on all three | A question a per-operation local score *cannot* answer but a fold across runs can — i.e., a population-level query with a ground truth | **High (~70%)** |
| **RH6** | *"Tags are ~50% accurate, so the profile is untrustworthy."* | 0.498 macro-F1 on 8 action classes; `prompt:continue` dominating Figure 2 | Task families reach 0.695; deterministic rules/regex path is exact by construction; V-measure 0.815 on ScienceWorld | Tag-noise sensitivity: inject error at measured rates, report top-k frame rank stability and RQ1/RQ2 degradation curves | **Med-High (~65%)** |
| **RH7** | *"100% precision is definitional, not empirical."* | Scope defined as the target process tree; controls are concurrent separate trees; 1,629/1,629 perfect | Recall is 96.6%, not 100%, so the join is not trivially saturated | Adversarial in-tree controls: double-fork, daemonized tool, PID reuse, post-exit effects, second agent in same tree | **Med-High (~60%)** |
| **RH8** | *"No developer, no decision, no outcome — actionability is asserted."* | Zero human subjects; zero downstream task; cited neighbors (Hodoscope 6–23× review reduction; TraceGraph resolve-rate gain) *do* show consequence | RQ2 localization ranking is a proxy for inspection effort | Small user study, or a mechanical downstream task (e.g., budget-cap policy derived from profile → measured savings on replay) | **Med (~55%)** |
| **RH9** | *"The flagship method loses to a one-line phase rule."* | Table 1: phase-only 0.654 > recurrence 0.649; abstract omits this | RQ3 shows recurrence >> phase-change control on OSWorld (0.680 vs 0.334) | Report both on the same untouched population; state when each is preferable | **Med (~50%)** |
| **RH10** | *"Segmentation contribution is unablated NPMI + unablated k-means."* | No frequency-only ablation, no alternative thresholding, no classical segmentation baseline | Method is described precisely enough to reproduce | NPMI-vs-count ablation; Otsu/percentile vs k-means; branching-entropy baseline | **Med (~50%)** |
| **RH11** | *"Double-blind is compromised."* | `project:agentsight` root frame in Figure 2; `agentpprof 0.2.37` binary name | Third-person citation of AgentSight is standard practice | Rename the root frame in the figure; anonymize the binary version string | **Low-Med (~30%) but cheap to eliminate** |

**Hypotheses I considered and reject as a reviewer:**
- *"Numbers are fabricated or inconsistent."* — Refuted. I recomputed 12 F1s and 6 derived statistics; all reproduce. Strong negative evidence for this hypothesis.
- *"Citations are fake or padded."* — The .bib has per-entry VERIFIED dates, PDF paths, abstracts, and USED_FOR fields, with unused entries explicitly marked. This is above-average citation hygiene. I will still verify primaries externally in Report 02, but my prior is that they are real.
- *"The four RQs are unanswerable / mis-scoped."* — They are reasonable and standard. My objections are to *construct validity* within RQ2 and RQ4 and to *generalization* within RQ1/RQ3, not to the RQ set itself. I do not recommend changing the RQs.

---

## 7. Strongest accept case, as I see it before external verification

The paper identifies a real and correctly stated gap: existing agent tools debug single runs and roll up metadata, but nothing folds heterogeneous cross-layer agent activity into query-time-selectable, weight-conserving, pprof-compatible aggregates. The operation/operation-stack abstraction is clean, the formalization is minimal and correct, the implementation is real and versioned, the arithmetic is verifiable, the metrics are standard and correctly sourced, the controls are matched, and the limitation disclosure is more honest than the field's norm. The RQ2 result — semantic grouping improving MAP over matched raw-action grouping on three complete independent benchmarks, with paired-bootstrap CIs excluding zero on all three — is a genuine, non-trivial finding that the grouping *layer* carries information. If the paper adds an untouched evaluation population, an end-to-end cost accounting, and honest positioning against OLAP/process-mining/trace-aggregation, this becomes a solid systems-for-AI contribution.

## 8. Strongest reject case, as I see it before external verification

The paper's first contribution is a data model that is a renaming of OLAP roll-up, positioned against neither OLAP nor process mining nor query-time trace aggregation; its second contribution is an unablated NPMI+k-means segmenter with **no untouched evaluation population** that loses to a one-line deterministic rule on the only population where that rule was measured; its third contribution's headline cost number excludes the dominant cost term; its problem-correspondence RQ turns out, on the paper's own post-hoc analysis, to show that profiling is a **tie-breaker on top of** per-operation debugging evidence — which is weak support for a thesis asserting that debugging is insufficient; and no named prior system is used as a baseline anywhere. The showcase figure is a session-stratified debugging view whose largest semantic bucket is `prompt:continue`.

## 9. Uncertainty

- **What I could verify with high confidence:** all arithmetic, internal consistency, figure content, citation inventory, page budget, uncited-but-present references, the 3B-vs-27B inconsistency, the session-in-stack contradiction.
- **What I could not verify blind and must check in Report 02:** whether CodeTraceBench, HINTBench, TraceElephant, AgentProcessBench, OSWorld-Human, Qwen3.6-27B, TraceProbe, Graphectory, Hodoscope, TraceGraph, MP-Bench exist as described with the stated counts; whether the named prior systems in fact lack the claimed conjunction of capabilities; whether the OLAP / process-mining / Canopy-Pivot-Tracing prior art I asserted from memory is as close as I believe; whether "benchmark-provided localizer hits" corresponds to a real released artifact and whether it is target-derived.
- **What I cannot resolve from the paper at all:** the RQ2 leakage question (B3.3), the CodeTraceBench selection denominator (M5), and the end-to-end tagging cost (B1).
- **Reviewer-position uncertainty:** my current disposition is *reject with strong encouragement to resubmit*, but B5 (positioning) and B1 (cost) are partly **writing/framing** fixes rather than new-science requirements, and B2/M3 are cheap experiments on existing artifacts. If external verification shows the prior-art overlap is thinner than I believe, my disposition moves toward *major revision*.

## 10. Next action

Proceed to Report 02: broad current-web search and primary-source verification of (a) every dataset/benchmark and its counts, (b) the Qwen3.6-27B model card, (c) each named prior system's actual capability set to test the conjunction claim, (d) the OLAP / process-mining / query-time-trace-aggregation prior art I asserted from memory, (e) recent multi-perspective failure-attribution and process-level trajectory evaluation work, and (f) contradictory evidence for the thesis. No paper file will be modified at any point.
